original: saviśeṣo'pyanubhūyamānau'nubhavaḥ kenacit yukatyābhāsena nirviśeṣa iti niṣkṛṣyamāṇaḥ sattātirekibhiḥ svāsādhāraṇaiḥ svabhāvāviśeṣairniṣkraṣṭavya iti niṣkarṣahetubhūtaiḥ sattātirekibhiḥ svāsādhāraṇaiḥ svabhāvaviśeṣaiḥ saviśeṣa evāvatiṣṭhate | ataḥ kaiścidviśeṣairviśiṣṭasyaiva vastuno'nye viśeṣā nirasyanta iti na kkacinnirviśeṣavastusiddhiḥ |

original: sarvaviśeṣarahitasya; tathābhūtasya kadācidapi grahaṇādarśanāt,anupapatteśca | kenacidviśeṣeṇe idamitthamiti hi sarvā pratītirupajāyate | trikoṇasāstrādisaṃsthānaviśeṣeṇa vinā kasyacidapi padārthasya grahaṇāyogāt | ato nirvikalpakamekajātīyadravyeṣu prathamapiṇḍagrahaṇam | dvitīyādipiṇḍagrahaṇaṃ savikalpakamityucyate |
analyzed: sarva viśeṣa rahitasya tathābhūtasya kadācid api grahaṇa adarśanāt anupapatteḥ ca idam ittham iti hi sarvā pratītiḥ upajāyate trikoṇa sa astra ādi saṃsthāna viśeṣeṇa vinā kasyacid api padārthasya grahaṇa ayogāt atas nirvikalpakam eka jātīya dravyeṣu prathama piṇḍa grahaṇam dvitīya ādi piṇḍa grahaṇam savikalpakam iti ucyate

original: tatra prathamapiṇḍagrahaṇe gotvāderanuvṛttākāratā na pratīyate | dvitīyādipiṇḍagrahaṇeṣvevānuvṛttipratītiḥ | prathamapratītyanusaṃhitavastusaṃsthāna rūpagotvāderanuvṛttidharmaviśiṣṭatvaṃ dvitīyādipiṇḍagrahaṇāvaseyamiti, dvitīyādigrahaṇasya savikalpakatvam |
analyzed: tatra prathama piṇḍa grahaṇe go tva ādeḥ anuvṛtta ākāra tā na pratīyate dvitīya ādi piṇḍa grahaṇeṣu eva anuvṛtti pratītiḥ prathama pratīti anusaṃhita vastu saṃsthāna rūpa go tva ādeḥ anuvṛtti dharma viśiṣṭa tvam dvitīya ādi piṇḍa grahaṇa avaseyam iti dvitīya ādi grahaṇasya savikalpaka tvam

original: sāstrā divastusaṃsthānarūpagotvederanuvṛttirna prathamapiṇḍagrahaṇe gṛhyate iti, prathamapiṇḍagrahaṇasya nirvikalpakatvam; na punaḥ saṃsthānarūpajātyāderagrahaṇāt | saṃsthānarūjātyāderapi aindriyikatvāviśeṣāt, saṃsthānena vinā saṃsthāninaḥ pratītyanupapatteśca prathamapiṇḍagrahaṇe'pi sasaṃsthānameva vastu itthamiti gṛhyate |
analyzed: sa astrā ādi vastu saṃsthāna rūpa go tva īdeḥ anuvṛttiḥ na prathama piṇḍa grahaṇe gṛhyate iti prathama piṇḍa grahaṇasya nirvikalpaka tvam na punar saṃsthāna rūpa jāti ādeḥ agrahaṇāt saṃsthāna rū jāti ādeḥ api aindriyika tva aviśeṣāt saṃsthānena vinā saṃsthāninaḥ pratīti anupapatteḥ ca prathama piṇḍa grahaṇe api sa saṃsthānam eva vastu ittham iti gṛhyate

original: ato dvitīyādipiṇḍagrahaṇeṣu gotvāderanuvṛttidharmaviśiṣṭatā saṃsthānivat saṃsthānavacca sarvadaiva gṛhyata iti teṣu savikalpakatvameva |
analyzed: atas dvitīya ādi piṇḍa grahaṇeṣu go tva ādeḥ anuvṛtti dharma viśiṣṭa tā saṃsthāni vat saṃsthāna vat ca sarvadā eva gṛhyate iti teṣu savikalpaka tvam eva

original: ataḥ pratyakṣasya kadācidapi na nirviśeṣaviṣayatvam |

original: ata eva sarvatra bhinnābhinnatvamapi nirastam | idamitthamiti pratītau idamitthambhāvayoraikyaṃ kathamiva pratyetuṃ śakyate? tatretthambhāvaḥ sāstrādisaṃsthānaviśeṣaḥ, tadviśeṣyaṃ dravyamidamaṃśaḥ ityanayoraikyaṃ pratītiparāhatameva | tathāhiprathamameva vastu pratīyamānaṃ sakaletaravyāvṛttameva pratīyate | vyāvṛttiśca gotvādisaṃsthānaviśeṣa
analyzed: atas eva sarvatra bhinna abhinna tvam api nirastam idam ittham iti pratītau idam itthambhāvayoḥ aikyam katham iva pratyetum śakyate tatra itthambhāvaḥ sa astra ādi saṃsthāna viśeṣaḥ tad viśeṣyam dravyam idam aṃśaḥ iti anayoḥ aikyam pratīti parāhatam eva tathā hi prathamam eva vastu pratīyamānam sakala itara vyāvṛttam eva pratīyate vyāvṛttiḥ ca go tva ādi saṃsthāna viśeṣaḥ

original: viśiṣṭatayatthamiti pratīteḥ | sarvatra viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvapratipattau tayoratyantabhedaḥ pratītyaiva suvyaktaḥ | tatra daṇḍakuṇḍalādayaḥ pṛthaksaṃsthānasaṃsthitāḥ svaniṣṭhāśca kadācit kkaciddravyāntaraviśeṣaṇatayāvatiṣṭhante | gotvādayastu dravyasaṃsthānatayaiva padārthabhūtāssanto dravyaviśeṣaṇatayā avasthitāḥ |
analyzed: pratīteḥ sarvatra viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya bhāva pratipattau tayoḥ atyanta bhedaḥ pratītyā eva su vyaktaḥ tatra daṇḍa kuṇḍala ādayaḥ pṛthak saṃsthāna saṃsthitāḥ sva niṣṭhāḥ ca kadācid kkacid dravya antara viśeṣaṇatayā avatiṣṭhante go tva ādayaḥ tu dravya saṃsthāna tayā eva padārtha bhūtāḥ santaḥ dravya viśeṣaṇatayā avasthitāḥ

original: ubhayatra viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvaḥ samānaḥ | tata eva tayorbhedapratipattiśca | iyāṃstu viśeṣaḥpṛthaksthitipratipattiyogyā daṇḍādayaḥ, gotvādayastu niyamena tadanarhāḥ iti | ato vastuvirodhaḥ pratītiparāhata iti pratītiprakāranihnavādevocyate | pratītiprakāro hi idamitthamityeva sarvasammataḥ |
analyzed: ubhayatra viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya bhāvaḥ samānaḥ tatas eva tayoḥ bheda pratipattiḥ ca iyān tu viśeṣaḥ pṛthak sthiti pratipatti yogyāḥ daṇḍa ādayaḥ go tva ādayaḥ tu niyamena tad anarhāḥ iti atas vastu virodhaḥ pratīti parāhataḥ iti pratīti prakāra nihnavāt eva ucyate pratīti prakāraḥ hi idam ittham iti eva sarva sammataḥ

original: tadetat sūtrakāreṇa, "naikasminnasambhavāt" iti suvyaktamupapāditam |

original: ataḥ pratyakṣasya saviśeṣaviṣayatvena pratyakṣādidṛṣṭasambandhaviśiṣṭaviṣayatvādanumānamapi saviśeṣaviṣayameva | pramāṇasaṅkhayāvivādepi sarvābhyugatapramāṇānāmayameva viṣaya iti na kenāpi pramāṇena nirviśeṣavastusiddhiḥ | vastugatasvabhāvaviśeṣaistadeva vastu nivirśeṣamiti vadan jananīvandhyātvapratijñāyāmiva svavāgvirodhamapi na jānāti ||
analyzed: atas pratyakṣasya sa viśeṣa viṣaya tvena pratyakṣa ādi dṛṣṭa sambandha viśiṣṭa viṣaya tvāt anumānam api sa viśeṣa viṣayam eva pramāṇa saṅkhaya avivāde pi sarva abhyugata pramāṇānām ayam eva viṣayaḥ iti na kena api pramāṇena nirviśeṣa vastu siddhiḥ vastugata svabhāva viśeṣaiḥ tat eva vastu nivirśeṣam iti vadan jananī vandhyā tva pratijñāyām iva sva vāc virodham api na jānāti

original: yattupratyakṣaṃ sanmātragrāhitvena na bhedaviṣayam, bhedaśca vikalpāsahatvādadurnirūpaḥityuktam, tadapi jātyādiviśiṣṭasyaiva vastunaḥ pratyakṣaviṣayatvāt jātyādereva pratiyogyapekṣayā vastunaḥ svasya ca bhedavyavahārahetutvācca dūrotsāritam |
analyzed: yat tu pratyakṣam sat mātra grāhi tvena na bheda viṣayam bhedaḥ ca vikalpa asaha tvāt adurnirūpaḥ iti uktam tat api jāti ādi viśiṣṭasya eva vastunaḥ pratyakṣa viṣaya tvāt jāti ādeḥ eva pratiyogi apekṣayā vastunaḥ svasya ca bheda vyavahāra hetu tvāt ca dūra utsāritam

original: saṃvedanavat rūpādivacca paratra vyavahāraviśeṣahetoḥ svasminnapi tadvayavahārahetutvaṃ yuṣmābhirabhyupetaṃ bhedasyāpi sambhavatyeva | ata eva ca nānavasthā'nyonyāśrayaṇañca |

original: ekakṣaṇavarttitve'pi pratyakṣajñānasya tasminneva kṣaṇe vastubhedarūpatatsaṃsthānarūpagotvādergṛhītatvāt kṣaṇāntaragrāhyaṃ na kiñcidiha tiṣṭhati || apicasanmātragrāhitve, ghaṭo'sti paṭo'stīti viśiṣṭaviṣayā prataītirvirudhyate |
analyzed: eka kṣaṇa vartti tve api pratyakṣa jñānasya tasmin eva kṣaṇe vastu bheda rūpa tad saṃsthāna rūpa go tva ādeḥ gṛhīta tvāt kṣaṇa antara grāhyam na kiñcid iha tiṣṭhati api ca sanmātra grāhi tve ghaṭaḥ asti paṭaḥ asti iti viśiṣṭa viṣayā prataītiḥ virudhyate

original: na ca ekasyaivārthasya viśeṣaṇabhedena viśiṣṭatābhedādanekārthatvaṃ padānāṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyavirodhi; ekasyaiva vastuno'nekaviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭatā pratipādanaparatvātsāmānādhikaraṇyasya, "bhinnapravṛvinimittānāṃ śabdānāmekasminnarthe vṛttiḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyam" iti hi śābdāḥ |

original: yaduktamekamevādvitīyamityatrādvitīyapadaṃ guṇato'pi sadvitīyatāṃ na sahate; atassarvaśākhāpratyayanyāyena kāraṇavākyānāmadvitīyavastupratipādanaparatvamabhyupagamanīyam, kāraṇatayopalakṣitasyādvitīyasya brahmaṇo lakṣaṇamidamucyate "satyaṃ jñānamanantaṃ brahma" iti;

original: ato lilakṣayiṣitaṃ brahma nirguṇameva, anyathā "nirguṇam" nirañjanam" ityādibhirvirodhaśceti tadanupapannam, jagadupādānasya brahmaṇaḥ svavyatiriktādhiṣṭhātrantaranivāraṇena vicitraśaktiyogapratipādanaparatvādadvitīyapadasya | tathaiva vicitraśaktiyogamevāvagamayati "tadaikṣata bahusyāṃ prajāyeyeti tattejo'sṛjata" ityādi |

original: sarvaśākhāpratyayanyāyaścātra bhavato viparītaphalaḥ, sarvaśākhāsu kāraṇānvayināṃ sarvajñatvādīnāṃ guṇānāmatropasaṃhārahetutvāt ataḥ kāraṇavākyasvabhāvādapi "satyaṃ jñānamanantaṃ brahma" ityanena saviśeṣameva pratipādyata iti vijñāyate ||

original: "yaḥ sarvajñaḥ sarvavit" "tadaikṣata" "seyaṃ devataikṣata" "sa īkṣata lokānnu sṛjā iti "nityo nityānāṃ cetanaścetanānāmeko bahūnāṃ yo vidadhāti kāmān" "jñājñau dvāvajāvīśanīśau" "tamīśvarāṇāṃ paramaṃ maheśvaraṃ taṃ daivatānāṃ paramaṃ ca daivatam |

original: nirguṇavākyānāṃ saguṇavākyānāṃ ca viṣayamapahatapāpmetyādyapipāsa ityantena heyaguṇān pratiṣidhya satyakāmaḥ satyasaṅkalpa iti brahmaṇaḥ kalyāṇaguṇān vidadhatīyaṃ śrutireva vivinaktīti saguṇanirguṇavākyayorvirodhābhāvādanyatarasya mithyāviṣayatāśrayaṇamapi nāśaṅkanīyam ||

original: "bhīṣā'smādvātaḥ pavate" ityādinā brahmaguṇānārabhya, "te ye śatam" ityanukrameṇa kṣetrajñānandātiśayamukatvā, "yato vāco nivartante aprāpya manasā saha ānandaṃ brahmaṇo vidvān" iti brahmaṇaḥ kalyāṇaguṇānantyamatyādareṇa vadatīyaṃ śrutiḥ |

original: "so'śnute sarvān kāmān saha brahmaṇā vipaścitā" iti brahmavedanaphalamavagamayat vākyaṃ parasya vipaścito brahmaṇo guṇānantyaṃ bravīti | vipaścitā brahmaṇā saha sarvān kāmān samaśnute | kāmyanta iti kāmāḥ kalyāṇaguṇāḥ | brahmaṇā saha tadguṇān sarvānaśnuta

original: ityarthaḥ | daharavidyāyām , "tasmin yadantastadanveṣṭavyam" itivat guṇaprādhānyaṃ vaktuṃ sahaśabdaḥ | phalopāsanayoḥ prakāraikyam, "yathākraturasmin loke puruṣo bhavati, tathetaḥ pretya bhavati" iti śrutyaiva siddham ||
analyzed: iti arthaḥ daharavidyāyām tasmin yat antar tat anveṣṭavyam iti vat guṇa prādhānyam vaktum saha śabdaḥ phala upāsanayoḥ prakāra aikyam yathā kratuḥ asmin loke puruṣaḥ bhavati tathā itas pretya bhavati iti śrutyā eva siddham

original: "yasyāmataṃ tasya matam...avijñātaṃ vijānatām" iti brahmaṇo jñānāviṣayatvamuktañcet, "brahmavidā pnoti param", "brahma veda brahmaiva bhavati" iti jñānānmokṣopadeśo na syāt | "asanneva sa bhavati, asadvrahmeti veda cet | asti brahmeti cedveda, santamenaṃ tato viduḥ" iti brahmaviṣayajñānāsadbhāvasadbhāvābhyāmātmanāśamātmasattāñca vadati;
analyzed: yasya amatam tasya matam avijñātam vijānatām iti brahmaṇaḥ jñāna aviṣaya tvam uktam ced brahma vidā pnoti param brahma veda brahmā eva bhavati iti jñānāt mokṣa upadeśaḥ na syāt asan eva sa bhavati asat vrahma iti veda ced asti brahma iti ced veda santam enam tatas viduḥ iti brahma viṣaya jñāna asadbhāva sadbhāvābhyām ātma nāśam ātma sattām ca vadati

original: athocyetabrahmavyatiriktasya mithyātvajñānamajñānavirodhīti na | idaṃ brahmavyatiriktamithyātvajñānaṃ kiṃ brahmayāthātmyājñānavirodhi, uta prapañcasatyatvarūpājñānavirodhi iti vivecanīyam | na tāvat brahmayāthātmyājñānavirodhi; atadviṣayatvāt | jñānājñānayorekaviṣayatve(tvena) hi virodhaḥ |
analyzed: athā ucyeta brahma vyatiriktasya mithyātva jñānam ajñāna virodhi iti na idam brahma vyatirikta mithyātva jñānam kim brahma yāthātmya ajñāna virodhi uta prapañca satya tva rūpa ajñāna virodhi iti vivecanīyam na tāvat brahma yāthātmya ajñāna virodhi a tad viṣaya tvāt jñāna ajñānayoḥ eka viṣaya tva itvena hi virodhaḥ

original: prapañcamithyātvajñānaṃ tatsatyatvarūpājñānena virudhyate | tena prapañcasatyatvarūpājñānameva bādhitamiti brahmasvarūpājñānaṃ tiṣṭhatyeva | brahmasvarūpājñānaṃ nāma tasya sadvitīyatvameva | tattu tadyvatiriktasya mithyātvajñānena nivṛttam | svarūpaṃ tu svānubhavasiddhamiti cetna;

original: kiñcāvidyayā prakāśaikasvarūpaṃ brahma tirohitamiti vadatā svarūpanāśa evoktassyāt | prakāśatirodhānaṃ nāma prakāśotpattipratibandhaḥ, vidyamānasya vināśo vā | prakāśasyānutpādyatvābhyupagamena prakāśatirodhānaṃ prakāśanāśa eva ||
analyzed: kiñca avidyayā prakāśa eka svarūpam brahma tirohitam iti vadatā sva rūpa nāśaḥ eva uktaḥ syāt prakāśa tirodhānam nāma prakāśa utpatti pratibandhaḥ vidyamānasya vināśaḥ vā prakāśasya anutpādya tva abhyupagamena prakāśa tirodhānam prakāśa nāśaḥ eva

original: ato nirviśeṣavastvaikyavādino bhedābhedavādinaḥ kevalabhedavādinaśca vaiyadhikaraṇyena sāmānādhikaraṇyena ca brahmātmabhāvopadeśāḥ sarve parityaktāḥ syuḥ | ekasmin vastuni kasya tādātmyamupadiśyate ? tasyaiveti cet, tat svavākyenaivāvagatamiti na tādātmyopadeśāvaseyamasti kiñcit |
analyzed: atas nirviśeṣa vastu aikya vādinaḥ bheda abheda vādinaḥ kevala bheda vādinaḥ ca vaiyadhikaraṇyena sāmānādhikaraṇyena ca brahma ātma bhāva upadeśāḥ sarve parityaktāḥ syuḥ ekasmin vastuni kasya tādātmyam upadiśyate tasya eva iti ced tat sva vākyena eva avagatam iti na tādātmya upadeśa avaseyam asti kiñcid

original: kalpitabhedanirasanamiti cettattu na sāmānādhikaraṇyatādātmyopadeśāvaseyamityuktam | sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ tu brahmaṇi prakāradvayapratipādanena virodhamevāvahet | bhedābhedavāde tu brahmaṇyevopādhisaṃsargāt tatprayuktāḥ jīvagatāḥ doṣā brahmaṇyeva prāduḥṣyuriti nirastanikhiladoṣakalyāṇaguṇātmakabrahmātmabhāvopadeśā hi virodhādeva parityaktāḥ syuḥ |
analyzed: kalpita bheda nirasanam iti ced tat tu na sāmānādhikaraṇya tādātmya upadeśa avaseyam iti uktam sāmānādhikaraṇyam tu brahmaṇi prakāra dvaya pratipādanena virodham eva āvahet bheda abheda vāde tu brahmaṇi eva upādhi saṃsargāt tad prayuktāḥ jīva gatāḥ doṣāḥ brahmaṇi eva prāduḥṣyuḥ iti nirasta nikhila doṣa kalyāṇa guṇa ātmaka brahma ātma bhāva upadeśāḥ hi virodhāt eva parityaktāḥ syuḥ

original: svābhāvikabhedābhedavāde'pi brahmaṇaḥ svata eva jīvabhāvābhyupagamāt guṇavat doṣāśca svābhāvikā bhaveyuriti nirdoṣabrahmatādātmyopadeśo viruddha eva | kevalabhedavādināṃ cātyantabhinnayoḥ kenāpi prakāreṇaikyāsaṃbhavādeva brahmātmabhāvopadeśā na saṃbhavantīti sarvavedāntaparityāgaḥ syāt ||
analyzed: svābhāvika bheda abheda vāda api brahmaṇaḥ svatas eva jīva bhāva abhyupagamāt guṇa vat doṣāḥ ca svābhāvikāḥ bhaveyuḥ iti nirdoṣa brahma tādātmya upadeśaḥ viruddhaḥ eva kevala bheda vādinām ca atyanta bhinnayoḥ kena api prakāreṇa aikya asaṃbhavāt eva brahma ātma bhāva upadeśāḥ na saṃbhavanti iti sarva vedānta parityāgaḥ syāt

original: nikhilopaniṣatprasiddhaṃ kṛtsnasya brahmaśarīrabhāvamātiṣṭhamānaiḥ brahmātmabhovopadeśāḥ sarve samyagupapāditā bhavanti | jātatiguṇayoriva dravyāṇāmapi śarīrabhāvena viśeṣaṇatve "gauraśvo manuṣyo devo jātaḥ puruṣaḥ karmabhiḥ" iti sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ lokavedayormukhyameva dṛṣṭacaram |
analyzed: nikhila upaniṣad prasiddham kṛtsnasya brahma śarīra bhāvam ātiṣṭhamānaiḥ brahma ātma bhova upadeśāḥ sarve samyak upapāditāḥ bhavanti jātati guṇayoḥ iva dravyāṇām api śarīra bhāvena viśeṣaṇa tve gauḥ aśvaḥ manuṣyaḥ devaḥ jātaḥ puruṣaḥ karmabhiḥ iti sāmānādhikaraṇyam loka vedayoḥ mukhyam eva dṛṣṭa caram

original: jātiguṇayorapi (hi) dravyaprakāratvameva "khaṇḍo gauḥ" "śuklaḥ paṭaḥ" iti sāmānādhikaraṇyanibandhanam | manuṣyatvādiviśiṣṭapiṇḍānātmapyātmanaḥ prakāratayaiva padārthatvāt "manuṣyaḥ puruṣaḥ ṣaṇḍo yoṣidātmā jātaḥ" iti sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ sarvatrānugatamiti prakāratvameva sāmānādhikaraṇyanibandhanam; na parasparavyāvṛttā jātyādayaḥ |
analyzed: jāti guṇayoḥ api hi dravya prakāra tvam eva khaṇḍaḥ gauḥ śuklaḥ paṭaḥ iti sāmānādhikaraṇya nibandhanam manuṣya tva ādi viśiṣṭa piṇḍa an ātma pya ātmanaḥ prakāratayā eva padārtha tvāt manuṣyaḥ puruṣaḥ ṣaṇḍaḥ yoṣit ātmā jātaḥ iti sāmānādhikaraṇyam sarvatra anugatam iti prakāra tvam eva sāmānādhikaraṇya nibandhanam na paraspara vyāvṛttāḥ jāti ādayaḥ

original: svaniṣṭhānāmeva hi dravyāṇāṃ kadācit kvaciddravyaviśeṣaṇatve matvarthīyapratyayo dṛṣṭaḥ, daṇḍī, kuṇḍalīti; na pṛthakpratipattisthityanarhāṇāṃ dravyāṇām | teṣāṃ viśeṣaṇatvaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyāvaseyameva ||
analyzed: sva niṣṭhānām eva hi dravyāṇām kadācid kvacid dravya viśeṣaṇa tve matvarthīya pratyayaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ daṇḍī kuṇḍalī iti na pṛthak pratipatti sthiti anarhāṇām dravyāṇām teṣām viśeṣaṇa tvam sāmānādhikaraṇya avaseyam eva

original: yadi "gauraśvo manuṣyo devaḥ puruṣo yoṣit ṣaṇḍa ātmā karmabhirjātaḥ" ityatra "khaṇḍo muṇḍo gauḥ" "śuklaḥ paṭaḥ" "kṛṣṇaḥ paṭaḥ" iti jātiguṇavadātmaprakāratvaṃ manuṣyādiśarīrāṇāmiṣyate, tarhi jātivyaktayoriva prakāraprakāriṇoḥ śarīrātmanorapi niyamena saha pratipattiḥ syāt; na caivaṃ dṛśyate |
analyzed: yadi gauḥ aśvaḥ manuṣyaḥ devaḥ puruṣaḥ yoṣit ṣaṇḍaḥ ātmā karmabhiḥ jātaḥ iti atra khaṇḍaḥ muṇḍaḥ gauḥ śuklaḥ paṭaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ paṭaḥ iti jāti guṇavat ātma prakāra tvam manuṣya ādi śarīrāṇām iṣyate tarhi jāti vyaktayoḥ iva prakāra prakāriṇoḥ śarīra ātmanoḥ api niyamena saha pratipattiḥ syāt na ca evam dṛśyate

original: na hi niyamena gotvādivat ātmāśrayatayaivātmanā saha manuṣyādiśarīraṃ paśyanti | ato manuṣya ātmeti sāmānādhikaraṇayaṃ lākṣaṇikameva | naitadevam; manuṣyādiśarīrāṇāmapyātmaikāśrayatvaṃ tadekaprayojanatvaṃ tatprakāratvañca jātyāditulyam | ātmaikāśrayatvamātmaviśleṣe śarīrasya vināśādavagamyate |
analyzed: na hi niyamena go tva ādi vat ātma āśrayatayā eva ātmanā saha manuṣya ādi śarīram paśyanti atas manuṣyaḥ ātmā iti lākṣaṇikam eva na etat evam manuṣya ādi śarīrāṇām api ātma eka āśraya tvam tad eka prayojana tvam tad prakāra tvam ca jāti ādi tulyam ātma eka āśraya tvam ātma viśleṣe śarīrasya vināśāt avagamyate

original: ātmaikaprayojanatvañca ta(tta)tkarmaphalabhogārthatayaiva sadbhavāt | tatprakāratvamapi, devo manuṣya satyātmaviśeṣaṇatayaiva pratīteḥ | etadeva hi gavādiśabdānāṃ vyaktiparyantatve hetuḥ | etatsvabhāvavirahādeva daṇḍakuṇḍalādīnāṃ viśeṣaṇatve daṇḍī kuṇḍalīti matvarthīyapratyayaḥ |
analyzed: ātma eka prayojana tvam ca tad tad karma phala bhoga arthatayā eva sadbhavāt tad prakāra tvam api devaḥ manuṣya satya ātma viśeṣaṇatayā eva pratīteḥ etat eva hi go ādi śabdānām vyakti paryanta tve hetuḥ etad svabhāva virahāt eva daṇḍa kuṇḍala ādīnām viśeṣaṇa tve daṇḍī kuṇḍalī iti matvarthīya pratyayaḥ

original: devamanuṣyādipiṇḍānātmaikāśrayatvatadekaprayojanatvatatprakāratvasvabhāvāt devo manuṣya ātmeti lokavedayoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyena vyavahāraḥ | jātivorniyamena sahapratītirubhayoścākṣuṣatvāt | ātmanastvacākṣuṣatvāt cakṣuṣā śarīragrahaṇavelāyāmātmā na gṛhyate | pṛthaggrahaṇayogyasya prakārataikasvarūpatvaṃ durghaṭamiti mā vocaḥ;
analyzed: deva manuṣya ādi piṇḍān ātma eka āśraya tva tad eka prayojana tva tad prakāra tva svabhāvāt devaḥ manuṣyaḥ ātmā iti loka vedayoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyena vyavahāraḥ jāti voḥ niyamena saha pratītiḥ ubhayoḥ cākṣuṣa tvāt ātmanaḥ tu acākṣuṣa tvāt cakṣuṣā śarīra grahaṇa velāyām ātmā na gṛhyate pṛthak grahaṇa yogyasya prakāra tā eka svarūpa tvam durghaṭam iti mā vocaḥ

original: tadayuktamniyogavākyārthavādinā hi niyogo niyojyaviśeṣaṇaṃ viṣayaḥ karaṇamitikarttavyatā prayoktā ca vaktavyāḥ | tatra hi niyojyaviśeṣaṇamanupādeyam | tacca nimittaṃ phalamiti dvidhā | atra kiṃ niyojya viśeṣaṇam? tacca kiṃ nimittaṃ phalaṃ veti vivecanīyam | brahma svarūpayāthātmyānubhavaścenniyojyaviśeṣaṇam;

original: tarhi na tannimittam, jīvanādivattasyāsiddhatvāt | nimittatve ca tasya nityatvenāpavargottarakālamapi jīvananimittāgnihotrādivat nityatadviṣayānuṣṭhānaprasaṅgaḥ | nāpi phalam, naiyogikaphalatvena svargādivadanityatvaprasaṅgāt ||

analyzed: kaḥ ca atra niyoga viṣayaḥ brahma eva iti ced na tasya nitya tvena abhavya rūpatvāt abhāva artha tvāt ca niṣprapañcam brahma sādhyam iti ced sādhya tve pi phalatvam eva abhāva artha tvāt na vidhi viṣaya tvam sādhya tvam ca kasya kim brahmaṇaḥ uta prapañca nivṛtteḥ na tāvat vrahmaṇaḥ siddha tvāt anitya tva prasakteḥ ca atha prapañca nivṛtteḥ

original: na tarhi brahmaṇaḥ sādhyatvam | prapañcanivṛttireva vidhiviṣaya iti cet na, tasyāḥ phalatvena vidhiviṣayatvāyogāt | prapañcanivṛttireva hi mokṣaḥ, sa ca phalam | asya ca niyogaviṣayatve niyogātprapañcanivṛttiḥ, prapañcanivṛttyā niyogaṃ itītaretarāśrayatvam ||

original: apicakiṃ nivarttanīyaḥ prapañco mithyārūpaḥ, satyo vā? | mithyārūpatve jñānanivatrtyatvādeva niyo gena na kiñcitprayojanam, niyogastu nivarttakajñānamutpādya taddvāreṇa prapañcasya nivarttaka iti cet, tatsvavākyādeva jātamiti niyogena na prayojanam, vākyārthajñānādeva brahmavyatiriktasya kṛtsnasya mithyābhūtasya prapañcasya vādhitatvāt
analyzed: apica kim nivarttanīyaḥ prapañcaḥ mithyārūpaḥ satyaḥ vā mithyārūpa tve jñāna nivatrtya tvāt eva niyo gena na kiñcid prayojanam niyogaḥ tu nivarttaka jñānam utpādya tad dvāreṇa prapañcasya nivarttakaḥ iti ced tad sva vākyāt eva jātam iti niyogena na prayojanam vākya artha jñānāt eva brahma vyatiriktasya kṛtsnasya mithyā bhūtasya prapañcasya vādhita tvāt

original: saparikarasya niyogasyāsiddhiśca | prapañcasya nivartyatve prapañcanivartako niyogaḥ kiṃ brahmasvarūpameva? uta tadvayatiriktaḥ? | yadi brahmasvarūpameva nivarttakasya nityatayā nivartyaprapañcasadbhāva eva na sambhavati | nityatvena niyogasya viṣayānuṣṭhānasādhyatvaṃ ca na ghaṭate | atha brahmasvarūpavyatiriktaḥ |
analyzed: sa parikarasya niyogasya asiddhiḥ ca prapañcasya nivartya tve prapañca nivartakaḥ niyogaḥ kim brahma svarūpam eva uta tad vayatiriktaḥ yadi brahma svarūpam eva nivarttakasya nitya tayā nivartya prapañca sadbhāvaḥ eva na sambhavati nitya tvena niyogasya viṣaya anuṣṭhāna sādhya tvam ca na ghaṭate atha brahma svarūpa vyatiriktaḥ

original: tasya kṛtsnaprapañcanivṛttirūpaviṣayānuṣṭhānasādhyatvena prayoktā ca naṣṭa ityāśrayābhāvādasiddhiḥ | prapañcanivṛttirūpaviṣayānuṣṭhānenaiva brahmasvarūpavyatiriktasya kṛtsnasya nivṛttattvānna niyoganiṣpādyaṃ mokṣākhyāṃ phalam |

analyzed: yatas vākyāt āparokṣya jñāna asambhavāt vākya artha jñānena avidyā na nivarttate tatas eva jīvanmuktiḥ api dūra utsāritā kā ca iyam jīvanmuktiḥ sa śarīrasya eva mokṣaḥ iti ced mātā me vandhyā iti vat asaṅgata artham vacaḥ yatas sa śarīra tvam bandhaḥ aśarīra tvam eva mokṣaḥ iti tvayā eva śrutibhiḥ upapāditam

original: atha saśarīratvapratibhāse vartamāne yasyāyaṃ pratibhāso mithyeti pratyayaḥ, tasya saśarīratvanivṛttiriti | na, mithyetipratyayena saśarīratvaṃ nivṛttaṃ cet kathaṃ saśarīrasya muktiḥ? ajīvato'pi muktissaśarīratvamithyāpratibhāsanivṛttireveti ko'yaṃ jīvanmuktiriti viśeṣaḥ |
analyzed: atha sa śarīra tva pratibhāse vartamāne yasya ayam pratibhāsaḥ mithyā iti pratyayaḥ tasya sa śarīra tva nivṛttiḥ iti na mithyā iti pratyayena sa śarīra tvam nivṛttam ced katham sa śarīrasya muktiḥ ajīvataḥ api muktiḥ sa śarīra tva mithyā pratibhāsa nivṛttiḥ eva iti kaḥ yam jīvanmuktiḥ iti viśeṣaḥ

original: atha saśarīratvapratibhāso bādhito'pi yasya dvicandrajñānavadanuvartate, sa jīvanmukta iti cet na, brahmavyatiriktasakalavastuviṣayatvādvādhakajñānasya, kāraṇabhūtāvidyākarmādidoṣaḥ saśarīratvapratibhāsena saha tenaiva bādhita iti bādhitānuvṛttirna śakyate vaktum |

original: dvicandrādau tu tatpratibhāsahetubhūtadoṣasya bādhakajñānabhūtacandraikatvajñānāviṣayatvenābādhitatvāt, dvicandrapratibhāsānuvṛttiryuktā |
analyzed: dvi candra ādau tu tad pratibhāsa hetu bhūta doṣasya bādhaka jñāna bhūta candra ekatva jñāna aviṣaya tvena abādhita tvāt dvi candra pratibhāsa anuvṛttiḥ yuktā

original: kiñca "tasya tāvadeva ciraṃ yāvanna vimokṣye atha sampatsye" iti sadvidyāniṣṭhasya śarīrapātamātramapekṣate mokṣa iti vadantīyaṃ śrutirjīvanmukiṃta vārayati | saiṣā jīvanmuktirāpastambenāpi nirastā "vedānimaṃ
analyzed: kiñca tasya tāvat eva ciram yāvat na vimokṣye atha sampatsye iti sat vidyā niṣṭhasya śarīrapāta mātram apekṣate mokṣaḥ iti vadantī iyam śrutiḥ vārayati sā eṣā jīvanmuktiḥ āpastambena api nirastā vedān imam

original: lokamamuñca parityajyātmānamanvicchet | buddhe kṣemaprāpaṇaṃ tacchāstrairvipratiṣiddham | buddhe cet kṣemaprāpaṇamihaiva na daḥkhamupalabheta | etena paraṃ vyākhyātam" iti | anena jñānamātrānmokṣaśca nirastaḥ | atassakalabhedanivṛttirūpā muktirjīvato na sambhavati |
analyzed: lokam amuñca parityajya ātmānam anvicchet buddhe kṣema prāpaṇam tat śāstraiḥ vipratiṣiddham buddhe ced kṣema prāpaṇam iha eva na daḥkham upalabheta etena param vyākhyātam iti anena jñāna mātrāt mokṣaḥ ca nirastaḥ atas sakala bheda nivṛtti rūpā muktiḥ jīvataḥ na sambhavati

original: tasmāddhyānaniyogena brahmāparekṣajñānaphalenaiva bandhanivṛttiḥ | na ca niyogasādhyatve mokṣasyānityatvabrasaktiḥ, pratibandhanivṛttimātrasyaiva sādhyatvāt | kiñca na niyogena sākṣādvandhanivṛttiḥ kriyate, kintu niṣprapañcajñānaikarasabrahmāparokṣyajñānena | niyogastu tadāparokṣyajñānaṃ janayati ||
analyzed: tasmāt dhyāna niyogena brahma aparekṣa jñāna phalena eva bandha nivṛttiḥ na ca niyoga sādhya tve mokṣasya anitya tva brasaktiḥ pratibandha nivṛtti mātrasya eva sādhya tvāt kiñca na niyogena sākṣāt vandha nivṛttiḥ kriyate kintu niṣprapañca jñāna ekarasa brahma aparokṣya jñānena niyogaḥ tu tadā aparokṣya jñānam janayati

original: kathaṃ niyogasya jñānotpattihetutvamiti cet kathaṃ vā bhavato anabhisaṃhitaphalānāṃ karmaṇāṃ vedanotpattihetutvam? | manonairmalyadvāreṇeti cet, mamāpi tathaiva | mama tu nirmale manasi śāstreṇa jñānamutpādyate | tava tu niyogena manasi nirmale jñānasāmagrī vaktavyeti cet dhyānaniyoganirmalaṃ mana eva sādhanamiti brūmaḥ |
analyzed: katham niyogasya jñāna utpatti hetu tvam iti ced katham vā bhavataḥ anabhisaṃhita phalānām karmaṇām vedanā utpatti hetu tvam manaḥ nairmalya dvāreṇa iti ced mama api tathā eva mama tu nirmale manasi śāstreṇa jñānam utpādyate tava tu niyogena manasi nirmale jñāna sāmagrī vaktavyā iti ced dhyāna niyoga nirmalam manaḥ eva sādhanam iti brūmaḥ

original: kenāvagamyata iti cet bhavato vā karmabhi rmano nirmalaṃ bhavati, nirmale manasi śravaṇamanananididhyāsanaissakaletaraviṣayavimukhasyaiva śāstraṃ nivartaka jñānamutpādayatīti kenāvagamyate? |
analyzed: kena avagamyate iti ced bhavataḥ vā karmabhiḥ manaḥ nirmalam bhavati nirmale manasi śravaṇa manana nididhyāsanaiḥ sakala itara viṣaya vimukhasya eva śāstram nivartaka jñānam utpādayati iti kena avagamyate

original: "vividiṣanti yajñena dānena tapasā'nāśakena" "śrotavyomantavyo nididhyāsitavyaḥ" "brahma veda brahmaiva bhavati" ityādibhiḥ śāstrairiti cet mamāpi "śrotavyomantavyo nididhyāsi tavyaḥ "brahmavidāpnoti param" "na cakṣuṣā gṛhyate nāpi vācā" "manasā tu viśuddhena" "hṛdā manīṣā manasā abhiklṛptaḥ" ityādibhiḥ śāstrai rdhyānaniyogena mano nirmalaṃ
analyzed: vividiṣanti yajñena dānena tapasā anāśakena śrotavyaḥ omantavyaḥ nididhyāsitavyaḥ brahma veda brahmā eva bhavati ityādibhiḥ śāstraiḥ iti ced mama api śrotavyaḥ omantavyaḥ nididhyāsi tavyaḥ brahma vidā āpnoti param na cakṣuṣā gṛhyate na api vācā manasā tu viśuddhena hṛdā manīṣā manasā abhiklṛptaḥ ityādibhiḥ śāstraiḥ dhyāna niyogena manaḥ nirmalam

original: bhavati | nirmalaṃ ca mano brahmāparokṣajñānaṃ janayatītyavagamyata iti niravadyam |
analyzed: bhavati nirmalam ca manaḥ brahma aparokṣa jñānam janayati iti avagamyate iti niravadyam

original: "nedaṃ yadidamupāsate" ityupāsyatvaṃ pratiṣiddhamiti cet naivam, nātra brahmaṇa upāsyatvaṃ pratiṣidhyate, api tu brahmaṇo jagadvairūpyaṃ pratipādyate | yadidaṃ jagadupāsate prāṇinaḥ, nedaṃ brahma, tadeva brahma tvaṃ viddhi, yadvācā'nabhyuditaṃ yena vāgabhyudyata iti vākyārthaḥ anyathā tadeva brahma tvaṃ viddhīti virudhdyate |
analyzed: na idam yat idam upāsate iti upāsya tvam pratiṣiddham iti ced na evam na atra brahmaṇaḥ upāsya tvam pratiṣidhyate api tu brahmaṇaḥ jagat vairūpyam pratipādyate yat idam jagat upāsate prāṇinaḥ na idam brahma tat eva brahma tvam viddhi yat vācā anabhyuditam yena vāc abhyudyataḥ iti vākya arthaḥ anyathā tat eva brahma tvam viddhi iti

original: dhyānavidhivaiyarthyaṃ ca syāt; ato brahmasākṣātkāraphalena dhyānaniyogenaivāparamārthabhūtasya kṛtsnasya draṣṭṛdṛśyādiprapañcarūpabandha sya nivṛttiḥ ||
analyzed: dhyāna vidhi vaiyarthyam ca syāt atas brahma sākṣātkāra phalena dhyāna niyogena eva aparamārtha bhūtasya kṛtsnasya nivṛttiḥ

original: yadapi kaiściduktambhedābhedayovirrodho na vidyata iti | tadayuktam; na hi śītoṣṇatamaḥ prakāśādivadbhedābhedāvekasmin vastuni saṅgacchete |
analyzed: yat api kaiścid uktam bheda abhedayoḥ virrodhaḥ na vidyate iti tat ayuktam na hi śīta uṣṇatamaḥ prakāśa ādi vat bheda abhedau ekasmin vastuni saṅgacchete

original: athocyetasarvaṃ hi vastujātaṃ pratīti vyavasthāpyam, sarvaṃ ca bhinnābhinnaṃ pratīyate | kāraṇātmanā jātyātmanā cābhinnam | kāryātmanā vyaktayātmanā ca bhinnam | chāyātapādiṣu virodhaḥ sahānavasthānala kṣaṇo bhinnādhāratvarūpaśca, kāryakāraṇayorjātivyakatyośca tadubhayamapi nopalabhyate, pratyuta ekameva vastu dvirūpaṃ pratīyate;
analyzed: atha ucyeta sarvam hi vastu jātam prati iti vyavasthāpyam sarvam ca bhinna abhinnam pratīyate kāraṇa ātmanā jāti ātmanā ca abhinnam kārya ātmanā vyaktayā ātmanā ca bhinnam chāyā ātapa ādiṣu virodhaḥ saha anavasthāna la kṣaṇaḥ bhinna ādhāra tva rūpaḥ ca kārya kāraṇayoḥ jāti vyakatyoḥ ca tat ubhayam api na upalabhyate pratyuta ekam eva vastu dvirūpam pratīyate

original: yathā "mṛdayaṃ ghaṭaḥ, khaṇḍo gauḥ muṇḍo gauḥ" iti | na caikarūpaṃ kiñcidapi vastu lāke dṛṣṭa caram, na ca tṛṇāderjvalanādivadabhedo bhedopamardī dṛśyata iti na vastuvirodhaḥ, mṛtsuvarṇagavāśvādyātmanāvasthitasyaiva ghaṭamukuṭakhaṇḍabaḍabādyātmanā cāvasthānāt | na cābhinnasya bhinnasya ca vastuno abhedo bhedaścaika evākāra itīśvarājñā |
analyzed: yathā mṛd ayam ghaṭaḥ khaṇḍaḥ gauḥ muṇḍaḥ gauḥ iti na ca eka rūpam kiñcid api vastu na ca tṛṇa ādeḥ jvalana ādi vat abhedaḥ bheda upamardī dṛśyate iti na vastu virodhaḥ mṛd suvarṇa gavāśva ādi ātmanā avasthitasya eva ghaṭa mukuṭa khaṇḍa baḍaba ādi ātmanā ca avasthānāt na ca abhinnasya bhinnasya ca vastunaḥ abhedaḥ bhedaḥ ca ekaḥ eva ākāraḥ iti īśvara ājñā

original: pratītatvādaikarūpyaṃ cet pratītatvādeva bhinnābhinnatvamiti dvairūpyamapyabhyupagamyatām | na hi viṣphāritākṣaḥ puruṣo ghaṭaśarāvakhaṇḍamuṇḍādiṣu vastuṣūpalabhyamāneṣu iyaṃ mṛt ayañca ghaṭaḥ, idaṃ gotvam iyaṃ vyaktiḥ, iti vivektuṃ śaknoti, api tu mṛdayaṃ ghaṭaḥ khaṇḍo gaurityeva pratyeti |
analyzed: pratīta tvāt aikarūpyam ced pratīta tvāt eva bhinna abhinna tvam iti dvairūpyam api abhyupagamyatām na hi viṣphārita akṣaḥ puruṣaḥ ghaṭa śarāva khaṇḍa muṇḍa ādiṣu vastuṣu upalabhyamāneṣu iyam mṛd ayam ca ghaṭaḥ idam go tvam iyam vyaktiḥ iti vivektum śaknoti api tu mṛd ayam ghaṭaḥ khaṇḍaḥ gauḥ iti eva pratyeti

original: anuvṛttibuddhibodhyaṃ kāraṇamākṛtiśca, vyāvṛttibuddhibodhyaṃ kāryaṃ vyaktiśceti vivinaktīti cet naivam; viviktākārānupalabdheḥ | na hi susūkṣmamapi nirīkṣamāṇaiḥ idamanuvartamānamidaṃ ca vyāvarttamānamiti puro'vasthite vastunyākārabheda upalabhyate |

original: yathā sampratipannaikye kāyrye viśeṣa caikatvabuddhirupajāyate; tathaiva sakāraṇe sasāmānye caikatvabuddhiraviśiṣṭopajāyate | evameva deśataḥ kālataścākārataścātyantavilakṣaṇeṣvapi vastuṣu tadevedamiti pratyabhijñā jāyate, ato dvayātmakameva vastu pratīyate iti kāryakāraṇayorjātivyaktayoścātyantabhedopapādanaṃ pratītiparāhatam |

original: kathaṃ tarhi vijñānamayaviṣayaśloke "vijñānaṃ yajñaṃ tanute" iti kevalavijñānaśabdopādānamupapadyate | jñāturevātmanaḥ svarūpamapi svaprakāśatayā vijñānamityucyata iti na doṣaḥ, jñānaikanirūpaṇīyatvācca jñātuḥ svarūpasya | svarūpanirūpaṇadharmaśabdā hi dharmamukhena dharmi svarūpamapi pratipādayanti, gavādiśabdavat | "kṛtyalyuṭo bahulam"
analyzed: katham tarhi vijñāna maya viṣaya śloke vijñānam yajñam tanute iti kevala vijñāna śabda upādānam upapadyate jñātuḥ eva ātmanaḥ sva rūpam api sva prakāśa tayā vijñānam iti ucyate iti na doṣaḥ jñāna eka nirūpaṇīya tvāt ca jñātuḥ sva rūpasya sva rūpa nirūpaṇa dharma śabdāḥ hi dharma mukhena dharmi sva rūpam api pratipādayanti gavādi śabda vat kṛtya lyuṭaḥ bahulam

original: kāṇvapāṭhagatasya paryāyasya sthāne "ya ātmani tiṣṭhan" iti paryāyamadhīyānā mādhyantināḥ kāṇvapāṭhagataṃ vijñānaśabdanirdiṣṭaṃ jīvātmeti sphuṭīkurvanti | vijñānamiti ca napuṃsakaliṅgaṃ vastutvābhiprāyam | tadevaṃ vijñānamayājjīvādanyastadantaraḥ paramātmā ānandamayaḥ | yadyapi "vijñānaṃ yajñaṃ tanute" iti ślokena jñānamātramevopādīyate, na jñātā;
analyzed: kāṇva pāṭha gatasya paryāyasya sthāne yaḥ ātmani tiṣṭhan iti paryāyam adhīyānāḥ mādhyantināḥ kāṇva pāṭha gatam vijñāna śabda nirdiṣṭam jīvātmā iti sphuṭīkurvanti vijñānam iti ca napuṃsaka liṅgam vastu tva abhiprāyam tat evam vijñāna mayāt jīvāt anyaḥ tad antaraḥ paramātmā ānanda mayaḥ yadi api vijñānam yajñam tanute iti ślokena jñāna mātram eva upādīyate na jñātā

original: tathāpi "anyontara ātmā vijñānamayaḥ" iti tadvān jñātaivopadiśyate; yathā "annādvai prajāḥ prajāyante" ityatra śloke kevalānnopādāne'pi "sa vā eṣa puruṣo'nnarasamayaḥ" ityatra nānnamātraṃ nirdiṣṭam; api tu tanmayaḥtadvikāraḥ | etatsarvaṃ hṛdi nidhāya sūtrakāraḥ svayameva "bhedavyapadeśāt" ityantarameva vadati |
analyzed: tathā api anyaḥ antaraḥ ātmā vijñāna mayaḥ iti tadvān jñātā eva upadiśyate yathā annāt vai prajāḥ prajāyante iti atra śloke kevala anna upādāne pi sa vai eṣa puruṣa unna rasa mayaḥ iti atra na anna mātram nirdiṣṭam api tu tad mayaḥ tad vikāraḥ etat sarvam hṛdi nidhāya sūtrakāraḥ svayam eva bheda vyapadeśāt iti antaram eva vadati

original: yaduktaṃ jagatkāraṇatayā nirdiṣṭasya "anena jīvenātmanā'nupraviśya" "tattvamasi" iti ca jīvasāmānādhikaraṇyanirdeśājjagatkāraṇamapi jīvasvarūpānnātiricyata iti kṛtvā jīvasyaiva svarūpaṃ "brahmavidāpnoti param" iti prakrāntamasukhādvayāvṛttatvenānandamaya ityupadiśyata iti;
analyzed: yat uktam jagat kāraṇatayā nirdiṣṭasya anena jīvena ātmanā anupraviśya tat tvam asi iti ca jīva sāmānādhikaraṇya nirdeśāt jagat kāraṇam api jīva svarūpāt na atiricyate iti kṛtvā jīvasya eva svarūpam brahma vidā āpnoti param iti prakrāntam asukha advaya āvṛtta tvena ānanda mayaḥ iti upadiśyate iti

original: tadayuktam, jīvasya cetanatve satyapi "tadaikṣata bahu syāṃ prajāyeyeti tattejo'sṛjata" iti svasaṅkalpapūrvakānantavicitrasṛṣṭiyogānupapatteḥ | śuddhāvasthasyāpi hi tasya sargādijagadvayāpārāsambhavo "jagadvayāpāravarjjam" "bhogamātrasāmyaliṅgāt" ityatropapādayiṣyate |
analyzed: tat ayuktam jīvasya cetana tve sati api tat aikṣata bahu syām prajāyeya iti tat tejaḥ sṛjataḥ iti sva saṅkalpa pūrvaka ananta vicitra sṛṣṭi yoga anupapatteḥ śuddha avasthasya api hi tasya sarga ādi jagat vayāpāra asambhavaḥ jagat vayāpāra varjam bhoga mātra sāmya liṅgāt iti atra upapādayiṣyate

original: kāraṇabhūtasya brahmaṇo jīvasvarūpatvānabhyupagame "anena jīvenātmanā" "tattvamasi" iti sāmānādhikaraṇyanirdeśaḥ kathamupapadyata iti cet;
analyzed: kāraṇa bhūtasya brahmaṇaḥ jīva svarūpa tva an abhyupagame anena jīvena ātmanā tattvam asi iti sāmānādhikaraṇya nirdeśaḥ katham upapadyate iti ced

original: kathaṃ vā nirastanikhiladoṣagandhasya satyasaṅkalpasya sarvajñasya sarvaśakteranavadhikātiśayāsaṅkhayeyakalyāṇaguṇagaṇasya sakalakāraṇabhūtasya brahmaṇaḥnānāvidhānantaduḥkhākarakarmādhīnacintitanimiṣitādisakalapravṛttijīvasvarūpatvam ? anyatarasya mithyātvenopapadyata iti cet;
analyzed: katham vā nirasta nikhila doṣa gandhasya satya saṅkalpasya sarvajñasya sarva śakteḥ anavadhika atiśaya asaṅkhayeya kalyāṇa guṇa gaṇasya sakala kāraṇa bhūtasya brahmaṇaḥ nānāvidha ananta duḥkha ākara karma adhīna cintita nimiṣita ādi sakala pravṛtti jīva svarūpa tvam anyatarasya mithyātvena upapadyate iti ced

original: kasya bhoḥ ? kiṃ heyasambandhasya ? kiṃ vā heyapratyanīkakakalyāṇaikatānasvabhāvasya ?
analyzed: kasya bhoḥ kim heya sambandhasya kim vā heya pratyanīkaka kalyāṇa ekatāna svabhāvasya

original: heyapratyanīkakalyāṇaikatānasya brahmaṇo'nādyavidyāśrayatvena heyasambandhamithyāpratibhāso mithyārūpa iti cet; vipratiṣiddhamidamabhidhīyate, brahmaṇo heyapratyanīkakalyāṇai
analyzed: heya pratyanīka kalyāṇa ekatānasya brahmaṇaḥ unādya vidyā āśraya tvena heya sambandha mithyā pratibhāsaḥ mithyārūpaḥ iti ced vipratiṣiddham idam abhidhīyate brahmaṇaḥ heya pratyanīka kalyāṇaiḥ

original: katānatvamanādyayidyāśrayatvenānantaduḥkhaviṣayamithyāpratibhāsaśrayatvañceti | avidyāśrayatvaṃ tatkāryaduḥkhapratibhāsāśrayatvañcaiva hi heyasamabandhaḥ | tatsambandhitvaṃ tatpratyanīkatvañca viruddhameva | tathāpi tasya mithyā tvānna virodha iti mā vocaḥ | mithyābhūtamaṣyapuruṣārtha eva; yannirasanāya sarve vedāntā ārabhyanta iti brūṣe |
analyzed: mithyā pratibhāsa śraya tvam ca iti avidyā āśraya tvam tad kārya duḥkha pratibhāsa āśraya tvañca eva hi heya sama bandhaḥ tad sambandhi tvam tad pratyanīka tvañca viruddham eva tathā api tasya mithyā tvāt na virodhaḥ iti mā vocaḥ mithyā bhūtam asi apuruṣa arthaḥ eva yat nirasanāya sarve vedāntāḥ ārabhyante iti brūṣe

original: nirasanīyāpuruṣārthayogaśca heyapratyanīkakalyāṇaikatānatayā virudhyate | kiṃ kurmaḥ ? "yenāśrutaṃ śrutaṃ bhavati" ityekavijñānena sarvavijñānaṃ pratijñāya "sadeva somyedamagra āsīt" ityādinā nikhilajagadekakāraṇatām "tadaikṣata bahu syām" iti satyasaṅkalpatāñca brahmaṇaḥ pratipādya tasyaiva brahmaṇaḥ "tattvamasi" iti
analyzed: nirasanīya apuruṣa artha yogaḥ ca heya pratyanīka kalyāṇa ekatāna tayā virudhyate kim kurmaḥ yena aśrutam śrutam bhavati iti eka vijñānena sarva vijñānam pratijñāya sat eva somya idam agre āsīt ityādinā nikhila jagat eka kāraṇatām tat aikṣata bahu syām iti satya saṅkalpa tām ca brahmaṇaḥ pratipādya tasya eva brahmaṇaḥ tattvam asi iti

original: sāmānādhikaraṇyenānantaduḥkhāśrayajīvaikyaṃ pratipāditam; tadanyathānupapattyā brahmaṇa evāvidyāśrayatvādi parikalpanīyamiti cet | śrutopapattaye'pyanupapannaṃ viruddhañca na kalpanīyam | atha heyasambandha eva pāramārthikaḥ, kalyāṇaikasvabhāvatā tu mithyābhūtā, hantaivaṃ tāpatrayābhihatacetanojjijīvayiṣayā pravṛttaṃ śāstram;
analyzed: sāmānādhikaraṇyena ananta duḥkha āśraya jīva aikyam pratipāditam tad anyathā anupapattyā brahmaṇaḥ evā avidyā āśraya tva ādi parikalpanīyam iti ced śruta upapattaye api anupapannam viruddham ca na kalpanīyam atha heya sambandhaḥ eva pāramārthikaḥ kalyāṇa eka svabhāva tā tu mithyā bhūtā hanta evam tāpa traya abhihata cetanā ujjijīvayiṣayā pravṛttam śāstram

original: tāpatrayābhiha tireva tasya pāramārthikī, kalyāṇaikasvabhāvastu bhrāntiparikalpita iti bodhayatsamyagujjīvayati | athaitaddoṣaparijihīrṣayā brahmaṇo nirviśeṣacinmātrasvarūpātiriktajīvatvaduḥkhitvādikaṃ satyasaṅkalpatvakalyāṇaguṇākaratvajagatkāraṇatvādyapi mithyābhūtamiti kalpanīyamiti cet; aho bhavatāṃ vākyārthaparyālocana
analyzed: tāpa traya abhiha tiḥ eva tasya pāramārthikī kalyāṇa eka svabhāvaḥ tu bhrānti parikalpitaḥ iti bodhayat samyak ujjīvayati atha etad doṣa parijihīrṣayā brahmaṇaḥ nirviśeṣa cit mātra svarūpa atirikta jīva tva duḥkhi tva ādikam satya saṅkalpa tva kalyāṇa guṇa ākara tva jagat kāraṇa tva ādi api mithyā bhūtam iti kalpanīyam iti ced aho bhavatām vākya artha paryālocana anuprahāra anuprahāra anuprahāra anuprahāra anuprahāra anuprahāra anuprahāra anuprahā

original: kuśalatā | ekavijñānena sarvavijñānapratijñānaṃ sarvasya mithyātve sarvasya jñātavyasyābhāvānna setsyati | yathaikavijñānaṃ paramārthaviṣayam, tadantargatañca tadā tajjñānena sarvavijñānamiti śakyate vaktum | na hi paramārthaśuktikājñānena tadāśrayamaparamārtharajataṃ jñātaṃ bhavati |
analyzed: kuśala tā eka vijñānena sarva vijñāna pratijñānam sarvasya mithyātve sarvasya jñātavyasya abhāvāt na setsyati yathā eka vijñānam paramārtha viṣayam tad antargatam ca tadā tad jñānena sarva vijñānam iti śakyate vaktum na hi paramārtha śuktikā jñānena tad āśrayam aparamārtha rajatam jñātam bhavati

original: athocyetaekavijñānena sarvavijñānapratijñāyāḥ ayamarthaḥnirviśeṣavastumātrameva satyam, anyadasatyamiti | na tarhi "yenāśrutaṃ śrutaṃ bhavatyamataṃ matamavijñātaṃ vijñātam" iti śrūyate; yena śrutenāśrutamapi śrutaṃ bhavatīti hyasya vākyasyārthaḥ |
analyzed: atha ucyeta eka vijñānena sarva vijñāna pratijñāyāḥ ayam arthaḥ nirviśeṣa vastu mātram eva satyam anyat asatyam iti na tarhi yena a śrutam śrutam bhavati amatam matam avijñātam vijñātam iti śrūyate yena śrutena aśrutam api śrutam bhavati iti hi asya vākyasya arthaḥ

original: kāraṇatayopalakṣitanirviśeṣavastumātrasyaiva sadbhāvaścetpratijñātaḥ, "yathā somyaikena mṛtpiṇḍena sarvaṃ mṛṇmayaṃ vijñātam" iti dṛṣṭānto'pi na ghaṭate | mṛtpiṇḍavijñānena hi tadvikārasya jñātatā nidaśirtā | tatrāpi vikārasyāsatyatābhipreteti cet;
analyzed: kāraṇatayā upalakṣita nirviśeṣa vastu mātrasya eva sadbhāvaḥ ced pratijñātaḥ yathā somya ekena mṛd piṇḍena sarvam mṛṇmayam vijñātam iti dṛṣṭāntaḥ api na ghaṭate mṛd piṇḍa vijñānena hi tad vikārasya jñāta tā tatra api vikārasya asatya tā abhipretā iti ced

original: mṛdvikārasya rajjusarpādivadasatyatvaṃ śuśrūṣorasiddhamiti pratijñātārthasambhāvanāpradarśanāya "yathā somya" iti prasiddhavadupanyāso na yujyate | na ca tattvamasyādivākyajanyajñānotpatteḥ prāgvikārajātasyāsatyatāmāpādayattarkānugṛhītamananugṛhītaṃ vā pramāṇamupalabhāmaha iti | ayamarthaḥ "tadananyatvamārambhaṇaśabdādibhyaḥ" ityatra vakṣyate |
analyzed: mṛd vikārasya rajju sarpa ādi vat asatya tvam śuśrūṣoḥ asiddham iti pratijñāta artha sambhāvanā pradarśanāya yathā somya iti prasiddha vat upanyāsaḥ na yujyate na ca tattvamasyādi vākya janya jñāna utpatteḥ prāk vikāra jātasya asatya tām āpādayat tarka anugṛhītam ananugṛhītam vā pramāṇam upalabhāmahe iti ayam arthaḥ tad ananyatvam ārambhaṇa śabda ādibhyaḥ iti atra vakṣyate

original: tathā "sadeva somyedamagra āsīdekamevādvitīyam" "tadaikṣata bahu syāṃ prajāyeyeti tattejo'sṛjata" "hantāhamimāstisro devatā anena jīvenātmanā'nupraviśya nāmarūpe vyākaravāṇi" "sanmūlāḥ somyemāḥ sarvāḥ prajāḥ sadāyatanāḥ satpratiṣṭhāḥ aitadātmyamidaṃ sarvam" ityādinā'sya jagataḥ sadātmakatā, sṛeṣṭeḥ pūrvakāle nāmarūpavibhāgaprahāṇam, jagadutpattau
analyzed: tathā sat eva somya idam agre āsīt ekam eva advitīyam tat aikṣata bahu syām prajāyeya iti tat tejaḥ sṛjata hanta aham imāḥ tisraḥ devatāḥ anena jīvena ātmanā anupraviśya nāma rūpe vyākaravāṇi sat mūlāḥ somya imāḥ sarvāḥ prajāḥ sat āyatanāḥ sat pratiṣṭhāḥ aitadātmyam idam sarvam ityādinā asya jagataḥ sat ātmaka tā sṛeṣṭeḥ pūrva kāle nāma rūpa vibhāga prahāṇam jagat utpattau

original: eva svabhāva iti na kaściddoṣa iti | tadidamasāram; sarveṣveva vākyeṣu padānāṃ vyutpattisiddhārthasaṃsargaviśeṣamātraṃ pratyāyyam, tatra samānādhikaraṇyavṛttānāmapi nīlādipadānāṃ nailyādiviśiṣṭa evārtho vyutpattisiddhaḥ padāntarārthasaṃsṛṣṭo abhidhīyate |
analyzed: eva svabhāvaḥ iti na kaścid doṣaḥ iti tat idam asāram sarveṣu eva vākyeṣu padānām vyutpatti siddha artha saṃsarga viśeṣa mātram pratyāyyam tatra samānādhikaraṇya vṛttānām api nīla ādi padānām nailya ādi viśiṣṭaḥ eva arthaḥ vyutpatti siddhaḥ pada antara artha saṃsṛṣṭaḥ abhidhīyate

original: yathā nīlamutpalamānayetyukte nīlimādiviśiṣṭamevā''nīyate, yathā ca, "bindhyā ṭavyāṃ madamudito mātaṅgagaṇastiṣṭhati" iti padadvayāvagataviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭa evārthaḥ pratīyate | evaṃ vedāntavākyeṣvapi samānādhikaraṇanirdeśeṣu tattadviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭameva brahmapratipattavyam | na ca viśeṣaṇavivakṣāyāmitaraviśiṣṭākāraṃ vastu anyena viśeṣṭavyam;
analyzed: yathā nīlam utpalam ānaya iti ukte nīlima ādi viśiṣṭam eva ānīyate yathā ca bindhyā ṭavyām mada muditaḥ mātaṅga gaṇaḥ tiṣṭhati iti pada dvaya avagata viśeṣaṇa viśiṣṭaḥ eva arthaḥ pratīyate evam vedānta vākyeṣu api samāna adhikaraṇa nirdeśeṣu tat tat viśeṣaṇa viśiṣṭam eva brahma pratipattavyam na ca viśeṣaṇa vivakṣāyām itara viśiṣṭa ākāram vastu anyena viśeṣṭavyam

original: api tu sarvairviśeṣaṇaiḥ svarūpameva viśeṣyam |
analyzed: api tu sarvaiḥ viśeṣaṇaiḥ svarūpam eva viśeṣyam

original: tathā hi "bhinnapravṛttinimittānāṃ śabdānāmekasminnarthe vṛttiḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyam" | anvayena nivṛttyā vā padāntarapratipādyākārāntarayuktatayā tasyaiva vastunaḥ padāntarapratipādyatvaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyakāryam | yathā "devadattaḥ śyāmo
analyzed: tathā hi bhinna pravṛtti nimittānām śabdānām ekasmin arthe vṛttiḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyam anvayena nivṛttyā vā pada antara pratipādya ākāra antara yukta tayā tasya eva vastunaḥ pada antara pratipādya tvam sāmānādhikaraṇya kāryam yathā devadattaḥ śyāmaḥ

original: yuvā lohitākṣo'dīno'kṛpaṇo'navadyaḥ iti | yatra tvekasmin vastuni samanvayāyogyaṃ viśeṣaṇadvayaṃ
analyzed: yuvā iti yatra tu ekasmin vastuni samanvaya ayogyam viśeṣaṇa dvayam

original: samānādhikaraṇapadanirdiṣṭam, tatrāpyanyataratpadamamukhyavṛttamāśrīyate, na dvayam; yathā "gaurvāhīkaḥ" iti | nīlotpalādiṣu tu viśeṣaṇadvayānvayāvirodhādekamevobhayaviśiṣṭaṃ pratipādyate |
analyzed: samāna adhikaraṇa pada nirdiṣṭam tatra api anyatarat padam amukhya vṛttam āśrīyate na dvayam yathā gauḥ vāhīkaḥ iti nīlotpala ādiṣu tu viśeṣaṇa dvaya anvaya avirodhāt ekam eva ubhaya viśiṣṭam pratipādyate

original: atha manuṣeekaviśeṣaṇapratisambandhitvena nirūpyamāṇaṃ viśeṣaṇāntarapratisambandhitvādvilakṣaṇamiti ghaṭapaṭayorivaikavibhaktinirdeśe apyaikyapratipādanāsambhavātsamānādhikaraṇaśabdasya na viśiṣṭapratipādanaparatvam, api tu viśeṣaṇamukhena svarūpamupasthāpya tadaikyapratipādanaparatvameveti | syādetadevam;

original: tathā hi, tairaupamanyavaprabhṛtibhirmaharṣibhiḥ "ātmānamevemaṃ vaiśvānaraṃ sampratyadhyeṣi tameva no brūhi" iti pṛṣṭaḥ kekayastebhyo vaiśvānarātmānamupadidikṣurviśeṣapraśnānyathānupapattyā vaiśvānarātmanyetaiḥ kiñcit jñātaṃ kiñcidajñātamiti vijñāya jñātājñātāṃśabubhutsayā tānekaikaṃ papraccha |

original: tatra "aupamanyava kaṃ tvamātmātmānamupāsse" iti pṛṣṭe "divameva bhagavo rājan" iti tena cokte divi tasya pūrṇavaiśvānarātmabudiṃdha nivartayan vaiśvānarasya dyaurmūrdheti copadiśaṃstasyā vaiśvānarāṃśabhūtāyā divassutejā iti guṇanāmadheyaṃ prācikhyapat | evaṃ satyayajñādibhirādityavāyvākāśapṛthivīnāmekaikenaikaikamupāsyamānatayā kathitānāṃ

original: bhavatyātmanastu kāmāya sarvaṃ priyaṃ bhavatyātmā vā are draṣṭavyaḥ śrotavyo maṃtavyo nididhyāsitavyaḥ maitreyyātmani khalvare dṛṣṭe śrute mate vijñāte idaṃ sarvaṃ viditam" iti | tatra saṃśayaḥ kimasmin vākye draṣṭavyatayopadiśyamānaḥ tantrasiddhapuruṣa eva ? athavā sarvajñaḥ satyasaṅkalpaḥ sarveśvara iti | kiṃ yuktam ? puruṣa iti |
analyzed: bhavati ātmanaḥ tu kāmāya sarvam priyam bhavati ātmā vai are draṣṭavyaḥ śrotavyaḥ maṃtavyaḥ nididhyāsitavyaḥ maitreyi ātmani khalu are dṛṣṭe śrute mate vijñāte idam sarvam viditam iti tatra saṃśayaḥ kim asmin vākye draṣṭavya tayā upadiśyamānaḥ tantra siddha puruṣaḥ eva athavā sarvajñaḥ satya saṅkalpaḥ sarva īśvaraḥ iti kim yuktam puruṣaḥ iti

original: kutaḥ ? ādimadhyāvasāneṣu puruṣasyaiva pratīteḥ, upakrame tāvatpatijāyāputravittapaśvādipriyatvayojjīvātmaiva pratīyate, madhye'pi "vijñānaghana evaitebhyo bhūtebhyassamutthāya tānyevānuvinaśyati na pretya saṃjñā'sti" ityutpattivināśayogātsa evāvagamyate |
analyzed: kutas ādi madhya avasāneṣu puruṣasya eva pratīteḥ upakrame tāvat pati jāyā putra vitta paśu ādi priya tvayā ujjīva ātmā eva pratīyate madhye api vijñāna ghanaḥ eva etebhyaḥ bhūtebhyaḥ samutthāya tāni eva anuvinaśyati na pretya saṃjñā asti iti utpatti vināśa yogāt saḥ eva avagamyate

original: tathānte ca "vijñātāramare kena vijānīyāt" iti sa eva jñātā kṣetrajña eva pratīyate, ne śvaraḥ, atastantrasiddhapuruṣapratipādanaparamidaṃ vākyamiti niścīyate | nanu "amṛtatvasya tu nāśā'sti vittena" ityupakramāt amṛtatvaprāptyupāyopadeśaparamidaṃ vākyamityavagamyate, tatkathaṃ puruṣapratipādanaparatvamasya vākyasya |
analyzed: tathā ante ca vijñātāram are kena vijānīyāt iti saḥ eva jñātā kṣetrajñaḥ eva pratīyate atas tantra siddha puruṣa pratipādana param idam vākyam iti niścīyate nanu amṛta tvasya tu na āśā asti vittena iti upakramāt amṛta tva prāpti upāya upadeśa param idam vākyam iti avagamyate tat katham puruṣa pratipādana paratvam asya vākyasya

original: taducyate, ata eva hyatra puruṣapratipādanam , tantre hyaciddharmādhyāsaviyuktapuruṣasvarupayāthātmyavijñānamevāmṛtatvahetutvenocyate, ato jīvātmanaḥ prakṛtiviyuktaṃ svarūpamihāmṛtatvāya "ātmā vā are draṣṭavyaḥ" ityādinopadiśyate |
analyzed: tat ucyate atas eva hi atra puruṣa pratipādanam tantre hi acit dharma adhyāsa viyukta puruṣa svarupa yāthātmya vijñānam eva amṛta tva hetu tvena ucyate atas jīvātmanaḥ prakṛti viyuktam sva rūpam iha amṛta tvāya ātmā vai are draṣṭavyaḥ ityādinā upadiśyate

original: sarveṣāmātmanāṃ prakṛtiviyuktaṃ svarūpamekarūpamiti prakṛtiviyuktasvātmayāthātmyavijñānena sarva evātmāno viditā bhavantītyātmavijñānena sarvavijñānamupapannam |
analyzed: sarveṣām ātmanām prakṛti viyuktam sva rūpam eka rūpam iti prakṛti viyukta sva ātma yāthātmya vijñānena sarve eva ātmānaḥ viditāḥ bhavanti iti ātma vijñānena sarva vijñānam upapannam

original: devādisthāvarānteṣu sarveṣu bhūteṣvātmasvarūpasya jñānaikaprakāratvāt "idaṃ sarvaṃ yadayamātmā" ityaikātmyopadeśaḥ, devādyākārāṇāmātmākāratvāt "sarvaṃ taṃ paradāt" ityādinā'nyatvaniṣedhaśca | "yatra hi dvaitamiva bhavati" iti ca nānātvaniṣedhenaikasvarūpe hyātmani devādiprakṛtipariṇāmabhedena nānātvaṃ mithyetyucyate |
analyzed: deva ādi sthāvara anteṣu sarveṣu bhūteṣu ātma svarūpasya jñāna eka prakāra tvāt idam sarvam yat ayam ātmā iti aikātmya upadeśaḥ deva ādi ākārāṇām ātma ākāra tvāt sarvam tam para dāt ityādinā anyatva niṣedhaḥ ca yatra hi dvaitam iva bhavati iti ca nānātva niṣedhena eka svarūpe hi ātmani deva ādi prakṛti pariṇāma bhedena nānātvam mithyā iti ucyate

original: "tasya ha vā etasya mahato bhūtasya niśvasitarametadyadṛgvedaḥ" ityādyapi prakṛteradhiṣṭhātṛtvena puruṣanimittatvājjagadutpatterupapadyate | evamasmin vākye puruṣapare niścite sati tadaikārthyāt sarve vedāntāstantrasiddhaṃ puruṣamevābhidadhatīti tadadhiṣṭhitā prakṛtireva jagadupādānam , neśvaraḥiti |
analyzed: tasya ha vai etasya mahataḥ bhūtasya niśvasitaram etat yat ṛgvedaḥ ityādi api prakṛteḥ adhiṣṭhātṛ tvena puruṣa nimitta tvāt jagat utpatteḥ upapadyate evam asmin vākye puruṣa pare niścite sati tad aikārthyāt sarve vedāntāḥ tantra siddham puruṣam eva abhidadhati iti tad adhiṣṭhitā prakṛtiḥ eva jagat upādānam na īśvaraḥ iti

original: evaṃ prāpte pracakṣmahe vākyānvayāditi | sarveśvara evāsminvākye pratīyate | kutaḥ ? evameva hi vākyākyavānāmanyonyānvayaḥ samañjaso bhavati |
analyzed: evam prāpte pracakṣmahe vākya anvayāt iti sarva īśvaraḥ eva asmin vākye pratīyate kutas evam eva hi vākya ākyavānām anyonya anvayaḥ samañjasaḥ bhavati

original: "amṛtatvasya tu nāśā'sti vittena" iti yājñavalkyenābhihite "yenā'haṃ nāmṛtā syāṃ kimahaṃ tena kuryyāṃ yadeva bhagavān veda tadeva me brūhi" ityamṛtatvānupāyatayā vittādyanādarāṇāmṛtatvaprāptyupāyameva prārthayamānāyai maitraiyyai tadupāyatayā draṣṭavyatayopadiṣṭo'yamātmā paramātmaiva, "tamevaṃ viditvā'timṛtyumeti" tamevaṃ vidvānamṛta iha bhavati
analyzed: amṛta tvasya tu na āśā asti vittena iti yājñavalkyena abhihite yena aham na amṛtā syām kim aham tena kuryyām yat eva bhagavān veda tat eva me brūhi iti amṛta tva anupāya tayā vitta ādi anādarāṇa amṛta tva prāpti upāyam eva prārthayamānāyai maitraiyyai tad upāya tayā draṣṭavya tayā upadiṣṭaḥ yam ātmā paramātmā eva tam evam viditvā atimṛtyum eti tam evam vidvān amṛtaḥ iha bhavati

original: nānyaḥ panthāḥ" ityādibhiramṛtatvasya paramapuruṣavedanaikopāyatayā pratipādanāt | paramapuruṣavibhūtibhūtasya prāpturātmanaḥ svarūpayāthātmyavijñānamapavargasādhanaparamapuruṣavedanopayogitayā'vagantavyam , na svata evopāyatvena; ato'tra paramātmaivāmṛtatvopāyatayā draṣṭavyaḥ" ityādinopadiśyate |
analyzed: na anyaḥ panthāḥ ityādibhiḥ amṛta tvasya paramapuruṣa vedanā eka upāya tayā pratipādanāt paramapuruṣa vibhūti bhūtasya prāptuḥ ātmanaḥ svarūpa yāthātmya vijñānam apavarga sādhana paramapuruṣa vedanā upayogi tayā avagantavyam na svatas eva upāya tvena atas utra paramātmā eva amṛta tva upāya tayā draṣṭavyaḥ ityādinā upadiśyate

original: tathā "tasya ha vā etasya mahato bhūtasya niśvasitametadyadṛgvedaḥ" ityādinā kṛtsnasya jagataḥ kāraṇatvamucyamānaṃ paramapuruṣādanyasya karmaparavaśasya muktasya nirvyāpārasya ca puruṣamātrasya na sambhavati | tathā "ātmano vā are darśanena " ityādinā ekavijñānena sarvavijñānamabhidhīyamānaṃ sarvātmabhūte paramātmanyevāvakalpate |
analyzed: tathā tasya ha vai etasya mahataḥ bhūtasya niśvasitam etat yat ṛgvedaḥ ityādinā kṛtsnasya jagataḥ kāraṇa tvam ucyamānam paramapuruṣāt anyasya karma paravaśasya muktasya nirvyāpārasya ca puruṣa mātrasya na sambhavati tathā ātmanaḥ vai are darśanena ityādinā eka vijñānena sarva vijñānam abhidhīyamānam sarva ātma bhūte paramātmani eva avakalpate

original: yattvetadekarūpatvādātmanāmekātmavijñānena sarvātmavijñānamucyata iti, tadayuktam ; acetanaprapañcajñānābhāvena sarvavijñānābhāvāt | pratijñopapādanāya ca "idaṃ brahmedaṃ kṣatram " ityupakramya" idaṃ sarvaṃ yadayamātmā"
analyzed: yat tu etat eka rūpa tvāt ātmanām eka ātma vijñānena sarva ātma vijñānam ucyate iti tat ayuktam acetana prapañca jñāna abhāvena sarva vijñāna abhāvāt pratijñā upapādanāya ca idam brahma idam kṣatram iti upakramya idam sarvam yat ayam ātmā

original: iti pratyakṣādisiddhaṃ cidacinmiśraṃ prapañcamidamiti nirddiśyaitadayamātmetyaikātmyopadeśaśca paramātmana evopapadyate na hīdaṃśabdavācyaṃ cidacinmiśraṃ jagatpuruṣeṇācitsaṃsṛṣṭena tadviyuktena svarūpeṇa vā'vasthitena caikmamupagacchati; ata eva "sarvaṃ taṃ parādādyo'nyatrātmanaḥ sarvaṃ veda" iti vyatiriktatvena savarvedananindāñca;
analyzed: iti pratyakṣa ādi siddham cit acit miśram prapañcam idam iti nirddiśya etat ayam ātmā iti aikātmya upadeśaḥ ca paramātmanaḥ eva upapadyate na hi idam śabda vācyam cit acit miśram jagatpuruṣeṇa acit saṃsṛṣṭena tad viyuktena svarūpeṇa vā avasthitena caikmam upagacchati atas eva sarvam tam parādāt yaḥ nyatra ātmanaḥ sarvam veda iti vyatirikta tvena savar vedana nindāñca

original: tathā prathame ca maitreyībrāhmaṇe "mahadbhūtamanantamapāram " iti śrutā mahattvādayo guṇāḥ paramātmana eva sambhavanti; atasya evātra pratipādyate | yattūktaṃ patijāyāputravittapaśvādipriyānvayino jīvātmana upakrame tvanveṣṭavyatayā pratipādanāttadviṣayamevedaṃ vākyamiti;
analyzed: tathā prathame ca maitreyībrāhmaṇe mahat bhūtam anantam apāram iti śrutāḥ mahat tva ādayaḥ guṇāḥ paramātmanaḥ eva sambhavanti atasya eva atra pratipādyate yat tu uktam pati jāyā putra vitta paśu ādi priya anvayinaḥ jīvātmanaḥ upakrame tu anveṣṭavya tayā pratipādanāt tad viṣayam eva idam vākyam iti

original: tadayuktam , ātmanastu kāmāya" ityātmaśabdena jīvātmasaṃśabdena tasya "ātmā vā are draṣṭavyaḥ" ityanenānanvayaprasaṅgāt | "ātmā vā are draṣṭavyaḥ" ityātmano draṣṭavyatvopayogitayā "ātmanastu kāmāya " ityupadiṣṭamiti pratīyate | ātmanastu kāmāya ātmanaḥ kāmasaṃpattaye; kāmyanta iti kāmāḥ, ātmana iṣṭasampattaya iti yāvat |
analyzed: tat ayuktam ātmanaḥ tu kāmāya iti ātma śabdena jīvātma saṃśabdena tasya ātmā vai are draṣṭavyaḥ iti anena ananvaya prasaṅgāt ātmā vai are draṣṭavyaḥ iti ātmanaḥ draṣṭavya tva upayogi tayā ātmanaḥ tu kāmāya iti upadiṣṭam iti pratīyate ātmanaḥ tu kāmāya ātmanaḥ kāma saṃpattaye kāmyante iti kāmāḥ ātmanaḥ iṣṭa sampattaye iti yāvat

original: na ca jīvātmana iṣṭasampattaye patyādayaḥ priyā bhavantītyukte sati tasya jīvasya
analyzed: na ca jīvātmanaḥ iṣṭa sampattaye pati ādayaḥ priyāḥ bhavanti iti ukte sati tasya jīvasya

original: svarūpamanveṣṭavyaṃ bhavati | priyameva hyanveṣṭavyam , na tu priyaṃ prati śeṣiṇaḥ priyaviyuktaṃ svarūpam; yasmādātmana iṣṭasampattaye patyādayaḥ priyā bhavanti tasmātpatyādipriyaṃ parityajya tadviyuktamātmasvarūpamanveṣṭavyamityasaṅgataṃ bhavati |
analyzed: sva rūpam anveṣṭavyam bhavati priyam eva hi anveṣṭavyam na tu priyam prati śeṣiṇaḥ priya viyuktam sva rūpam yasmāt ātmanaḥ iṣṭa sampattaye pati ādayaḥ priyāḥ bhavanti tasmāt pati ādi priyam parityajya tad viyuktam ātma sva rūpam anveṣṭavyam iti asaṅgatam bhavati

original: pratyuta na patyādiśeṣatayā patyādīnāṃ priyatvam , api tvātmanaḥ śeṣatayā patyādīnāṃ priyatvamityukte svaśeṣatayā ta evopādeyāḥ syuḥ | "ātmanastu kāmāya sarvaṃ priyaṃ bhavati" ityasya pareṇānanvaye vākyabhedaḥ prasajyate, abhyupagamyamāne'pi vākyabhede pūrvavākyasya na kiñcitprayojanaṃ dṛśyate;
analyzed: pratyuta na pati ādi śeṣatayā pati ādīnām priya tvam api tu ātmanaḥ śeṣatayā pati ādīnām priya tvam iti ukte sva śeṣatayā te eva upādeyāḥ syuḥ ātmanaḥ tu kāmāya sarvam priyam bhavati iti asya pareṇa ananvaye vākya bhedaḥ prasajyate abhyupagamyamāne api vākya bhede pūrva vākyasya na kiñcid prayojanam dṛśyate

original: ataḥ patyādi sarvaṃ priyaṃ parityajyātmana evānveṣṭavyatvaṃ yathā pratīyate tathā vākyārtho varṇanīyaḥ, so'yamucyate "amṛtatvasya tu nāśā'sti vittena" iti vittādīnāṃ nityanirdoṣaniratiśayānandarūpāmṛtatvaprāptyanupāyatāmuktavā vittaputrapatijāyādīnāṃ sātiśayaduḥkhamiśrakādācitkapriyatvamanubhūyamānaṃ na patyādisrūpaprayuktam , api tu
analyzed: atas pati ādi sarvam priyam parityajya ātmanaḥ eva anveṣṭavya tvam yathā pratīyate tathā vākya arthaḥ varṇanīyaḥ saḥ yam ucyate amṛta tvasya tu na āśā asti vittena iti vitta ādīnām nitya nirdoṣa niratiśaya ānanda rūpa amṛta tva prāpti anupāya tām uktavā vitta putra pati jāya ādīnām sa atiśaya duḥkha miśra kādācitka priya tvam anubhūyamānam na pati ādi srūpa prayuktam api tu

original: niratiśayānandasvabhāvaparamātmaprayuktam ; ato ya eva svayaṃ niratiśayānandassannanyeṣāmapi priyatvaleśāspadatvamāpādayati sa paramātmaiva draṣṭavya ityupadiśyate |
analyzed: niratiśaya ānanda svabhāva paramātma prayuktam atas yaḥ eva svayam niratiśaya ānandaḥ san anyeṣām api priya tva leśa āspada tvam āpādayati sa paramātmā eva draṣṭavyaḥ iti upadiśyate

original: tadayamarthaḥ, na vā are patyuḥ kāmāya patiḥ priyo bhavati na hi patijāyāputravittādayo matprayojanāyāhamasya priyaḥ syāmiti svasaṅkalpātpirayā bhavanti, api tvātmanaḥ kāmāya, paramātmanaḥ svārāghakapirayapratilambhanarūpeṣṭanirvṛttaya ityarthaḥ|
analyzed: tat ayam arthaḥ na vai are patyuḥ kāmāya patiḥ priyaḥ bhavati na hi pati jāyā putra vitta ādayaḥ mad prayojanāya aham asya priyaḥ syām iti sva saṅkalpāt pirayāḥ bhavanti api tu ātmanaḥ kāmāya paramātmanaḥ sva ārāghaka piraya pratilambhana rūpa iṣṭa nirvṛttayaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: paramātmā hi karmabhirārādhitastattattkarmānuguṇaṃ pratiniyatadeśakālasvarūpaparimāṇamārādhakānāṃ tattadvastugataṃ priyatvamāpādayati "eṣa hyevānandayāti" iti śruteḥ | na tu
analyzed: paramātmā hi karmabhiḥ ārādhitaḥ tad tad karma anuguṇam pratiniyata deśa kāla sva rūpa parimāṇam ārādhakānām tad tad vastu gatam priya tvam āpādayati eṣa hi eva ānandayāti iti śruteḥ na tu

original: tmana evābhidhānāt "ātmanastu kāmāya" "ātmā vā are draṣṭavyaḥ" iti pūrvoktaprakriyayobhayatrātmaśabdāvekaviṣayau||matāntareṇāpi jīvaśabdena paramātmābhidhānopapādanāyāha
analyzed: tmanaḥ eva abhidhānāt ātmanaḥ tu kāmāya ātmā vai are draṣṭavyaḥ iti pūrvokta prakriyayā ubhayatra ātma śabdau eka viṣayau mata antareṇa api jīva śabdena paramātma abhidhāna upapādanāya āha

original: pratijñāsiddherliṅgamāśmarathyaḥ || 20 ||
analyzed: pratijñā siddheḥ liṅgam āśmarathyaḥ 20

original: ekavijñānena sarvavijñānapratijñāsiddhedaṃ liṅgam , yajjīvātmavāciśabdaiḥ paramātmano'bhidhānamityāśmarathya ācāryyo manyate sma | yadyayaṃ jīvaḥ paramātmakāryyatayā paramātmaiva na bhavettadā tadyvatiriktatayā paramātmavijñānādetadvijñānaṃ na setsyati |
analyzed: eka vijñānena sarva vijñāna pratijñā siddhā idam liṅgam yat jīva ātma vāci śabdaiḥ paramātmanaḥ abhidhānam iti āśmarathyaḥ ācāryyaḥ manyate sma yadi ayam jīvaḥ paramātma kāryyatayā paramātmā eva na bhavet tadā paramātma vijñānāt etat vijñānam na setsyati

original: "ātmā vā idameka evāgra āsīt" iti prāksṛṣṭerekatvāvadhāraṇāt , "yathā sudīptātpāvakādvisphuliṅgāssahasraśaḥ prabhante sarūpāḥ| tathā'kṣarādvividhāḥ somya bhāvāḥ prajāyante tatra caivāpiyanti" ityādibhirbrahmaṇo jīvānāmutmattiśravaṇāttasminneva layaśravaṇācca jīvānāṃ brahmakāryyatvena brahmaṇaikyamavagamyate, ato jīvaśabdena paramātmābhidhānamiti ||
analyzed: ātmā vai idam ekaḥ eva agre āsīt iti prāk sṛṣṭeḥ ekatva avadhāraṇāt yathā su dīptāt pāvakāt visphuliṅgāḥ sahasraśas prabhante sarūpāḥ tathā akṣarāt vividhāḥ somya bhāvāḥ prajāyante tatra ca eva apiyanti ityādibhiḥ brahmaṇaḥ jīvānām utmatti śravaṇāt tasmin eva laya śravaṇāt ca jīvānām brahma kāryyatvena brahmaṇā aikyam avagamyate atas jīva śabdena paramātma abhidhānam iti

original: suvālopaniṣadi ca "yaḥ pṛthivīmantare sañcaran yasya pṛthivī śarīram" ityārabhya tadvadeva cidacitossarvāvasthayoḥ paramātmaśarīratvamabhidhāya "eṣa sarvabhūtāntarātmā'pahatapāpmā divyo deva eko nārāyaṇaḥ" iti tasya sarvabhūtāni pratyātmatvama

original: loke ca śarīraśabdo ghaṭādiśabdavadekākāradravyaniyatavṛttibhanāsāditaḥ krimikīṭapataṅgasarpanarapaśu prabhṛtiṣvatyantavilakṣaṇākāreṣu dravyeṣu agauṇaḥ prayujyamāno dṛśyate | tena tasya pravṛttinimitta vyavasthāpanaṃ sarvaprayogānuguṇyenaiva kāryam | tvaduktañca "karmaphala bhogahetuḥ" ityādikaṃ pravṛttinimitta lakṣaṇaṃ na sarvaprayogānuguṇam |

original: sarvaśarīrāṇāmavidyākalpitatvasyaivābhāvādayuktam | tadabhāvaścābādhitasya satyatopapādanāt | yacca cetanādanyasya jaḍatvadarśanātsarvacetanānāmananyatvamuktaṃ tadapi sukhaduḥkhavyavasthayā bhedopapādanādeva nirastam |
analyzed: sarva śarīrāṇām avidyā kalpita tvasya eva abhāvāt ayuktam tad abhāvaḥ ca abādhitasya satyatā upapādanāt yat ca cetanāt anyasya jaḍa tva darśanāt sarva cetanānām ananya tvam uktam tat api sukha duḥkha vyavasthayā bheda upapādanāt eva nirastam

original: yattu mayaivātmavanti madavidyākalpitānyahameva sarvaṃ cetanajātamityahamarthasyaikyamupapāditam tadajñātasvasiddhāntasya bhrāntijalpitam; ahaṃ tvamādyatharvilakṣaṇaṃ cinmātraṃ hyātmā tvanmate | kiñca nirviśeṣacinmātrātireki sarvaṃ mithyeti vadato mokṣārthaśravaṇādiprayatno niṣphalaḥ, avidyākāryatvāt;
analyzed: yat tu mayā eva ātmavanti mad avidyā kalpitāni aham eva sarvam cetana jātam iti ahamarthasya aikyam upapāditam tat ajñāta sva siddhāntasya bhrānti jalpitam aham tvam ādi atharvi lakṣaṇam cit mātram hi ātmā tvad mate kiñca nirviśeṣa cit mātra atireki sarvam mithyā iti vadataḥ mokṣa artha śravaṇa ādi prayatnaḥ niṣphalaḥ avidyā kārya tvāt

original: śuktikārājatādiṣu rajatādyupādānādiprayatnavat | mokṣārthaprayatno'pi vyarthaḥ, kalpitācāryāyattajñānakāryatvāt śukaprahlādavāmadevādiprayatnavat |
analyzed: śuktikā rājata ādiṣu rajata ādi upādāna ādi prayatna vat mokṣa artha prayatnaḥ api vyarthaḥ kalpita ācārya āyatta jñāna kārya tvāt śuka prahlāda vāmadeva ādi prayatna vat

original: tattvamasyādivākyajanyajñānaṃ na bandhanivartakam, avidyākalpitavākyajanyatvātsvayamavidyātmakatvāt, avidyākalpitajñātrāśrayatvāt kalpitācāryāyattaśravaṇajanyatvādvā, svāpnabandhanivattarnavākyajanyajñānavat |
analyzed: tattvamasi ādi vākya janya jñānam na bandha nivartakam avidyā kalpita vākya janya tvāt svayam avidyā ātmaka tvāt avidyā kalpita jñātra āśraya tvāt kalpita ācārya āyatta śravaṇa janya tvāt vā

original: kiñca nirviśeṣacinmātraṃ brahma mithyā, avidyākāryajñānagamyatvāt avidyākalpitajñātrāśrayajñānagamyatvāt avidyātmakajñānagamyatvādvā, yadevaṃ tattathā, yathā svāpnagandharvanagarādiḥ | na ca nirviśeṣacinmātraṃ brahma svayaṃ prakāśate, yena na pramāṇāntaramapekṣate |
analyzed: kiñca nirviśeṣa cit mātram brahma mithyā avidyā kārya jñāna gamya tvāt avidyā kalpita jñātṛ āśraya jñāna gamya tvāt avidyā ātmaka jñāna gamya tvāt vā yat evam tat tathā yathā svāpna gandharvanagara ādiḥ na ca nirviśeṣa cit mātram brahma svayam prakāśate yena na pramāṇa antaram apekṣate

original: yattvātmasākṣikaṃ svayaṃ prakāśajñānaṃ dṛśyate, tattu jñeyaviśeṣasiddhirūpaṃ jñātṛgatameva dṛśyata iti pūrvamevoktam | yāni ca tasya nivirśeṣatvasādhakāni yauktikāni jñānānyupanyastāni tāni cānantaroktairavidyākāryatvādityādibhiranumānairnirastāni | na ca nirviśeṣasya cinmātrasyājñānasākṣitvamahaṅkārādi
analyzed: yat tu ātma sākṣikam svayam prakāśa jñānam dṛśyate tat tu jñeya viśeṣa siddhi rūpam jñātṛ gatam eva dṛśyate iti pūrvam eva uktam yāni ca tasya nivirśeṣa tva sādhakāni yauktikāni jñānāni upanyastāni tāni ca anantara uktaiḥ avidyā kārya tvāt ityādibhiḥ anumānaiḥ nirastāni na ca nirviśeṣasya cit mātrasya ajñāna sākṣi tvam ahaṅkāra ādi

original: jagadbhramaścopapadyate sākṣitvabhramādayo'pi hi jñātṛviśeṣagatā dṛṣṭāḥ, na jñaptimātragatāḥ, na ca tasya prakāśatvaṃ svāyattaprakāśatā vā sidhyati; prakāśo hi kasyacitpuruṣasya kañcanātharviśeṣaṃ pratisiddhirūpo dṛśyate, tata eva hi tasya svayamprakāśatopapadyate bhavadbhirapi | na cātādṛśasya nirviśeṣasya prakāśatā sambhavati |
analyzed: jagat bhramaḥ ca upapadyate sākṣi tva bhrama ādayaḥ api hi jñātṛ viśeṣa gatāḥ dṛṣṭāḥ na jñapti mātra gatāḥ na ca tasya prakāśa tvam sva āyatta prakāśa tā vā sidhyati prakāśaḥ hi kasyacid puruṣasya kañcana athar viśeṣam pratisiddhi rūpaḥ dṛśyate tatas eva hi tasya svayamprakāśa tā upapadyate bhavadbhiḥ api na ca a tādṛśasya nirviśeṣasya prakāśa tā sambhavati

original: yaḥ punaḥ svagoṣṭhīṣvaparamārthādapi paramātharkāryaṃ dṛśyata ityudghoṣaḥ so'pi, tāni kāryāṇi sarvāṇyabādhitakalpāni vyāvahārikasatyāni; vastutastvavidyātmakānyeveti svābhyupagamādeva nirastaḥ | asmābhirapi sarvatraparamārthādeva kāraṇātsarvakāryotpattimupapādayadbhiḥ pūrvameva nirastaḥ |
analyzed: yaḥ punar sva goṣṭhīṣu aparamārthāt api paramātharka āryam dṛśyate iti udghoṣaḥ saḥ upi tāni kāryāṇi sarvāṇi abādhita kalpāni vyāvahārika satyāni vastutas tu avidyā ātmakāni eva iti sva abhyupagamāt eva nirastaḥ asmābhiḥ api sarvatra paramārthāt eva kāraṇāt sarva kārya utpattim upapādayadbhiḥ pūrvam eva nirastaḥ

original: na ca tvayaiṣāmanumānānāṃ śrutivirodho vaktuṃ śakyate, śruterapyavidyākāryatvenāvidyātmakatvena coktadṛṣṭāntebhyo viśeṣābhāvāt | yattu brahmaṇo'pāramārthikajñānagamyatve'pi paścāttanabādhādarśanādbrahma satyameveti, tadasat; duṣṭakāraṇajanyajñānagamyatve niścite sati paścāttanabādhādarśanasyākiñcitkaratvāt |
analyzed: na ca tvayā eṣām anumānānām śruti virodhaḥ vaktum śakyate śruteḥ api avidyā kārya tvena avidyā ātmaka tvena ca ukta dṛṣṭāntebhyaḥ viśeṣa abhāvāt yat tu brahmaṇā upāramārthika jñāna gamya tve pi paścāttana bādhā darśanāt brahma satyam eva iti tat asat duṣṭa kāraṇa janya jñāna gamya tve niścite sati paścāttana bādhā darśanasya akiñcitkara tvāt

original: yathā śūnyameva tattvamiti vākyajanyajñānasya paścāttanabādhādarśane'pi doṣamūlatvaniścayādeva tadarthasyāsatyatvam |
analyzed: yathā śūnyam eva tattvam iti vākya janya jñānasya paścāttana bādhā darśana api doṣa mūla tva niścayāt eva tad arthasya asatya tvam

original: kiñca "neha nānāsti kiñcana" "vijñānamānandaṃ brahma" iti vijñānamātrātiriktasya kṛtsnasya vastujātasya niṣedhakatvena sarvasmāt paratvātpaścāttanabādhādarśanamucyate, śūnyameva tattvamiti tasyāpyabhāvaṃ vadatastasmātparatvena paścāttanabādho dṛśyate | sarvaśūnyatvātirekiniṣedhāsambhavāttasyaiva paścāttanabādhādarśanam;
analyzed: kiñca na iha nānā asti kiñcana vijñānam ānandam brahma iti vijñāna mātra atiriktasya kṛtsnasya vastu jātasya niṣedhaka tvena sarvasmāt paratvāt paścāttana bādhā darśanam ucyate śūnyam eva tattvam iti tasya api abhāvam vadataḥ tasmāt paratvena paścāttana bādhaḥ dṛśyate sarva śūnyatva atireki niṣedha asambhavāt tasya eva paścāttana bādhā darśanam

original: doṣamūlatvaṃ tu pratyakṣādīnāṃ vedāntajanmanaḥ sarvaśūnyajñānasyāpyaviśiṣṭam;
analyzed: doṣa mūla tvam tu pratyakṣa ādīnām vedānta janmanaḥ sarva śūnya jñānasya api aviśiṣṭam

original: ataḥ sarvaṃ vijñānajātaṃ pāramārthikajñātṛgatam; svayaṃ ca paramārthabhūtamarthaviśeṣasiddhirūpam; tatra kiñcit, jñānaṃ doṣamūlam; doṣaśca paramārthaḥ, kiñcicca nirdoṣaṃ pāramārthikasāmagrījanyamiti yāvannābhyupeyate, na tāvatsatyamithyārthavyavasthā,lokavyavahāraśca setsyati|
analyzed: atas sarvam vijñāna jātam pāramārthika jñātṛ gatam svayam ca paramārtha bhūtam artha viśeṣa siddhi rūpam tatra kiñcid jñānam doṣa mūlam doṣaḥ ca paramārthaḥ kiñcid ca nirdoṣam pāramārthika sāmagrī janyam iti yāvat na abhyupeyate na tāvat satya mithyā artha vyavasthā loka vyavahāraḥ ca setsyati

original: lokavyavahāro hi pāramārthiko bhrāntirūpaśca pāramārthikajñātṛgatārthaviśeṣasiddhirūpaprakāśapūrvakaḥ, nirviśeṣasanmātrasya tu pāramārthikasyā'pāramāthirkasya ca pratibhāsāderhetutvāsambhavāllokavyavahāro na sambhavati |
analyzed: loka vyavahāraḥ hi pāramārthikaḥ bhrānti rūpaḥ ca pāramārthika jñātṛ gata artha viśeṣa siddhi rūpa prakāśa pūrvakaḥ nirviśeṣa sanmātrasya tu pāramārthikasya a pāramāthirkasya ca pratibhāsa ādeḥ hetu tva asambhavāt loka vyavahāraḥ na sambhavati

original: yacca tairniradhiṣṭhānabhramāsambhavāt sarvādhyāsādhiṣṭhānasya sanmātrasya pāramārthikatvamuktam, tadapi doṣadoṣāśrayatvajñātṛtvajñānānāmapāramārthyepi bhramopapattivadadhiṣṭhānāpāramārthyepi bhramopapatternirastam |
analyzed: yat ca taiḥ niradhiṣṭhāna bhrama asambhavāt sarva adhyāsa adhiṣṭhānasya sat mātrasya pāramārthika tvam uktam tat api doṣa doṣa āśraya tva jñātṛ tva jñānānām apāramārthye ipi bhrama upapatti vat adhiṣṭhāna apāramārthye ipi bhrama upapatteḥ nirastam

original: atha adhiṣṭhānāpāramārthye na kvacidbhramo dṛṣṭa iti sanmātrasya pāramārthikatvamavaśyāśrayaṇīyamiti manyase hanta tarhi doṣadoṣāśrayatvajñātṛtvajñānānāmapāramārthye'pi na kvacidbhramo dṛṣṭa iti darśanānuguṇyena teṣāmapi pāramārthyamavaśyāśrayaṇīyamiti na kaścidviśeṣo'nyatra tatsaṃrambhāt |
analyzed: atha adhiṣṭhāna apāramārthye na kvacid bhramaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ iti sanmātrasya pāramārthika tvam avaśya āśrayaṇīyam iti manyase hanta tarhi doṣa doṣa āśraya tva jñātṛ tva jñānānām apāramārthye pi na kvacid bhramaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ iti darśana ānuguṇyena teṣām api pāramārthyam avaśya āśrayaṇīyam iti na kaścid viśeṣaḥ anyatra tad saṃrambhāt

original: yattu bhedapakṣe'pyatītakalpānāmānantyātsarveṣāmātmanāṃ muktatvena baddhāsambhavādbaddhamuktavyavasthā na sambhavatīti; tadātmānantyena parihṛtam |
analyzed: yat tu bheda pakṣe pi atīta kalpānām ānantyāt sarveṣām ātmanām mukta tvena baddha asambhavāt baddha mukta vyavasthā na sambhavati iti tat ātma ānantyena parihṛtam

original: yattvātmanāṃ bhinnatve māṣasarṣapaghaṭapaṭādivatsaṅkhayāvattvamavarjjanīyamiti, tatra ghaṭādīnāmapyanantatvāt dṛṣṭāntaḥ sādhyavikalassyāt, daśaghaṭāḥ sahasraṃ māṣā iti saṅkhayāvattvaṃ dṛśyata iti cetsatyam , tattu na ghaṭādisvarūpagatam, api tu deśakālādyupādhimadghaṭādigatam, tādṛśaṃ tu saṅkhayāvattvamātmanāmabhyupagacchāmaḥ |
analyzed: yat tu ātmanām bhinna tve māṣa sarṣapa ghaṭa paṭa ādi vat saṅkhayāvat tvam avarjanīyam iti tatra ghaṭa ādīnām api ananta tvāt dṛṣṭāntaḥ sādhya vikalaḥ syāt daśa ghaṭāḥ sahasram māṣāḥ iti saṅkhayāvat tvam dṛśyate iti ced satyam tat tu na ghaṭa ādi svarūpa gatam api tu deśa kāla ādi upādhimat ghaṭa ādi gatam tādṛśam tu saṅkhayāvat tvam ātmanām abhyupagacchāmaḥ

original: na ca tāvatā sarvamuktiprasaṅgaḥ,ātmasvarūpānantyāt |
analyzed: na ca tāvatā sarva mukti prasaṅgaḥ ātma svarūpa ānantyāt

original: yattu ātmanāṃ bhinnatve ghaṭādivajjaḍatvānātmatvakṣayitvaprasaṅga iti, tadayuktam; ekajātīyānāṃ bhedasya tajjātīyānāṃ jātyantarīyatvānāpādakatvāt | na hi ghaṭādīnāṃ bhedasteṣāṃ paṭatvamāpādayati |
analyzed: yat tu ātmanām bhinna tve ghaṭa ādi vat jaḍa tva anātma tva kṣayi tva prasaṅgaḥ iti tat ayuktam eka jātīyānām bhedasya tad jātīyānām jāti antarīya tva anāpādaka tvāt na hi ghaṭa ādīnām bhedaḥ teṣām paṭa tvam āpādayati

original: yattu bhinnatve vastutaḥ paricchedāddeśakālābhyāmapi paricchedo brahmaṇaḥ prasajyata ityanantatvaṃ brahmaṇo na sidhyatīti, tadayuktam; vastutaḥ paricchinnānāmapi deśakālaparicchedasya nyūnādhikabhāvenāniyamadarśanāt; deśakālasambandheyattāyāḥ pramāṇāntarāyattanirṇayatvena brahmaṇaḥ sarvadeśakālasambandhasyāpi pramāṇāntarādāpatato virodhābhāvāt |
analyzed: yat tu bhinna tve vastutas paricchedāt deśa kālābhyām api paricchedaḥ brahmaṇaḥ prasajyate iti ananta tvam brahmaṇaḥ na sidhyati iti tat ayuktam vastutas paricchinnānām api deśa kāla paricchedasya nyūna adhika bhāvena aniyama darśanāt deśa kāla sambandha iyattāyāḥ pramāṇa antara āyatta nirṇaya tvena brahmaṇaḥ sarva deśa kāla sambandhasya api pramāṇa antarāt āpatataḥ virodha abhāvāt

original: vastutaḥ paricchedamātrādapi sarvaprakāraparicchedarahitatvābhāvādānantyāsiddhiriti cet, tadbhavato'pyavidyāvilakṣaṇatvaṃ brahmaṇo abhyupeyataḥ samānam; atassato'vidyāvilakṣaṇatvābhyupagamādbrahmaṇo'pi bhinnatvena bhedaprayuktā doṣāssarve tavāpi prasajyeran | yadyavidyāvilakṣaṇatvaṃ nābhyupeyate; tarhyavidyātmakatvameva brahma syāt |
analyzed: vastutas pariccheda mātrāt api sarva prakāra pariccheda rahita tva abhāvāt ānantya asiddhiḥ iti ced tat bhavatā api avidyā vilakṣaṇa tvam brahmaṇaḥ abhyupeyataḥ samānam atas sataḥ vidyā vilakṣaṇa tva abhyupagamāt brahmaṇaḥ api bhinna tvena bheda prayuktāḥ doṣāḥ sarve tava api prasajyeran yadi avidyā vilakṣaṇa tvam na abhyupeyate tarhi avidyā ātmaka tvam eva brahma syāt

original: "satyaṃ jñānamanantaṃ brahma" iti lakṣaṇavākyamapi tata evāpātharkaṃ syāt | bhedatattvānabhyupagame hi svapakṣaparapakṣasādhanadūṣaṇādivivekābhāvātsarvamasamañjasaṃ syāt | ānantyaprasiddhiśca deśakālaparicchedarahitatvamātreṇa; na vastuto'pi paricchedarahitatvena, tathāvidhasya śaśaviṣāṇāyamānasyānupalabdheḥ |
analyzed: satyam jñānam anantam brahma iti lakṣaṇa vākyam api tatas eva apātharkam syāt bheda tattva anabhyupagame hi sva pakṣa para pakṣa sādhana dūṣaṇa ādi viveka abhāvāt sarvam asamañjasam syāt ānantya prasiddhiḥ ca deśa kāla pariccheda rahita tva mātreṇa na vastutas api pariccheda rahita tvena tathāvidhasya śaśaviṣāṇāyamānasya anupalabdheḥ

original: bhedavādinastu sarvacidacidvastuśarīratvenabrahmaṇassarvaprakāratvātsvataḥ parato'pi paricchedo na vidyate | tadevaṃ kāraṇādbhinnasya kāyarsya satyatvādbrahmakāryaṃ kṛtsnaṃ jagadbrahmaṇo'nyadeva |
analyzed: bheda vādinaḥ tu sarva cit acit vastu śarīra tvena brahmaṇaḥ sarva prakāra tvāt svatas paratas api paricchedaḥ na vidyate tat evam kāraṇāt bhinnasya satya tvāt brahma kāryam kṛtsnam jagat brahmaṇaḥ anyat eva

original: iti prāpte pracakṣmahe tadananyatvamārambhaṇaśabdādibhyaḥ | tasmātparamakāraṇādbrahmaṇaḥ, ananyatvaṃ jagataḥ ārambhaṇaśabdādibhyaḥ tadupapādayadbhayo'vagamyate | ārambhaṇaśabda ādiryeṣāṃ vākyānām, tānyārambhaṇaśabdādīni "vācārambhaṇaṃ vikāronāmadheyaṃ mṛttiketyeva satyam" "sadeva somyedamagra āsīdekamevādvitīyaṃ, tadaikṣata
analyzed: iti prāpte pracakṣmahe tat ananyatvam ārambhaṇa śabda ādibhyaḥ tasmāt parama kāraṇāt brahmaṇaḥ ananyatvam jagataḥ ārambhaṇa śabda ādibhyaḥ tat upapādayat bhayā uvagamyate ārambhaṇa śabdaḥ ādiḥ yeṣām vākyānām tāni ārambhaṇa śabda ādīni vācā ārambhaṇam vikāraḥ nāmadheyam mṛttikā iti eva satyam sat eva somya idam agre āsīt ekam eva advitīyam tat aikṣata

original: bahu syāṃ prajāyeyeti tattejo'sūjata" "anena jīvenātmanā'nupraviśya" "sanmūlāssomyemāssarvāḥ prajāssadāyatanāḥ satpratiṣṭhāḥ aitadātmyamidaṃ sarvaṃ tatsatyaṃ sa ātmā tattvamasi śvetaketo" ityetāni; prakaraṇāntarasthānyapyevañjātīyakānyatrābhipretāni | etāni hi vākyāni cidacidātmakasya jagataḥ parasmādbrahmaṇo'nanyatvamupapādayanti |

analyzed: kṣipāmi ajastram aśubhān āsurīṣu eva yoniṣu iti ca sa bhagavān puruṣottama uvāpta samasta kāmaḥ sarvajñaḥ sarva īśvaraḥ satya saṃkalpaḥ sva māhātmya anuguṇa līlā pravṛttaḥ etāni karmāṇi samīcīnāni etāni asamīcīnāni iti karmma dvaividhyam saṃvidhāya ca sarveṣām kṣetrajñānām sāmānyena pradiśya

original: saṃjñāmūrtiklṛptiḥ nāmarūpavyākaraṇam, tattrivṛtkurvataḥ parasyaiva brahmaṇaḥ, tasyaiva nāmarūpavyākaraṇopadeśāt | trivṛtkaraṇaṃ kurvata eva hi nāmarūpavyākaraṇamupadiśyate "seyaṃ devataikṣata hantā'hamimāstastro devatā anena jīvenātmanā'nupraviśya nāmarūpe vyākaravāṇi tāsāṃ trivṛtaṃ trivṛtamekaikāṃ karavāṇi" iti samānakartṛkatvapratīteḥ |

original: trivṛtkaraṇaṃ caturmukhasyāṇḍāntarvartino na sambhavati, trivṛtkṛtaistejobannairhyaṇḍa

original: mutpādyate, caturmukhasya cāṇḍe sambhavaḥ smaryyate "tasminnaṇḍe'bhavadvrahmā sarvalokapitāmahaḥ" iti | astrivṛtkaraṇaṃ ca parasyaiva brahmaṇaḥ, tatsamānakartṛkaṃ nāmarūpavyākaraṇañca tasyaiveti vijñāyate | kathaṃ tarhyanena jīveneti saṅgacchate;

original: evaṃ ca "praviśya nāmarūpe vyākaravāṇi" iti praviśatiruttamapuruṣaścākliṣṭau mukhyārthāveva bhavataḥ | praveśavyākaraṇayoḥ samānakartṛkatvamapyupapadyate | caturmukhaśarīrakasya parasyaiva brahmaṇaḥ karma devādivicitrasṛṣṭiriti caturmukhakartṛkasṛṣṭiprakaraṇe nāmarūpavyākriyopadeśaścopapadyate |

original: na ca kāryabhedena samuccaye sambhavati pākṣikabādhagarbhavikalpo nyāyaḥ | sambhavati ca prāsādakhaṭvāparyaṅkavannāḍyādīnāṃ kāryabhedaḥ | tatra nāḍīpurītatau prāsādakhaṭvāsthānīyau; brahma tu paryaṅkasthānīyam | ato brahmaiva sākṣātsuṣuptisthānam || 7 ||
analyzed: na ca kārya bhedena samuccaye sambhavati pākṣika bādha garbha vikalpaḥ nyāyaḥ sambhavati ca prāsāda khaṭvā paryaṅka vat nāḍī ādīnām kārya bhedaḥ tatra nāḍī purītatau prāsāda khaṭvā sthānīyau brahma tu paryaṅka sthānīyam atas brahma eva sākṣāt suṣupti sthānam

original: ataḥ pravodho'smāt || 8 ||
analyzed: ataḥ pravodhaḥ usmāt

original: yato brahmaiva sākṣātsuṣuptisthānam, ato'smādvrahmaṇaḥ eṣāṃ jīvānāṃ pravodhaḥ śrūyamāṇa upapadyate,"sata āgamya na viduḥ sata āgacchāmahe" ityādiṣu || 8 || | tadabhāvādhikaraṇaṃ samāptam ||
analyzed: yatas brahma eva sākṣāt suṣupti sthānam atas asmāt vrahmaṇaḥ eṣām jīvānām pravodhaḥ śrūyamāṇaḥ upapadyate sataḥ āgamya na viduḥ sataḥ āgacchāmahe ityādiṣu tad abhāva adhikaraṇam samāptam
