original: sa eva tu karmmānusmṛtiśabdavidhibhyaḥ || 9 ||
analyzed: saḥ eva tu karmma anusmṛti śabda vidhibhyaḥ

original: kiṃ suṣupta eva prabodhasamaye uttiṣṭhati? utānya? iti saṃśaye asya sakalopādhivinirmuktasya brahmaṇi sampannasya muktādavilakṣaṇatvena prācīnaśarīrendriyādisambandhābhāvādanyaḥ iti prāpta ucyate sa eva tviti | tu śabdaḥ pakṣaṃ vyāvarttayati; sa evottiṣṭhati, kutaḥ? karmānusmṛtiśabdavidhibhyaḥ |
analyzed: kim suṣuptaḥ eva prabodha samaye uttiṣṭhati uta anyaḥ iti saṃśaye asya sakala upādhi vinirmuktasya brahmaṇi sampannasya muktāt avilakṣaṇa tvena prācīna śarīra indriya ādi sambandha abhāvāt anyaḥ iti prāptaḥ ucyate saḥ eva tu iti tu śabdaḥ pakṣam vyāvarttayati saḥ eva uttiṣṭhati kutas karma anusmṛti śabda vidhibhyaḥ

original: karma tāvatsuṣuptena pūrvakṛtaṃ puṇyapāparūpaṃ tatvajñānātprāk tenaiva bhoktavyam | anusmṛtirapiya evāhaṃ suptaḥ sa eva pratibuddho'smīti | śabdopi suṣuptaprabuddhassa eveti darśayati "ta iha vyāghro vā siṃho vā vṛko vā varā ho vā kīṭo vā pataṅgo vā maśako vā daṃśo vā maśamo vā yadyadbhavanti tathā bhavanti" iti | vidhayaśca mokṣā
analyzed: karma tāvat suṣuptena pūrva kṛtam puṇya pāpa rūpam tatva jñānāt prāk tena eva bhoktavyam anusmṛtiḥ api yaḥ eva aham suptaḥ saḥ eva pratibuddhaḥ asmi iti śabdaḥ api suṣupta prabuddhaḥ saḥ eva iti darśayati te iha vyāghraḥ vā siṃhaḥ vā vṛkaḥ vā varāḥ vā kīṭaḥ vā pataṅgaḥ vā maśakaḥ vā daṃśaḥ vā maśamaḥ vā yat yat bhavanti tathā bhavanti iti vidhayaḥ ca mokṣāḥ

original: rthāḥ suṣuptasyamuktatve'narthakāḥ syuḥ, na cāsau sarvopādhivinirmukta āvirbhūtasvarūpaḥ "tadyatraitatsuṣuptaḥ" iti suṣuptaṃ prakṛtya "nāha khalvayamevaṃ saṃpratyātmānaṃ jānātyayamahamasmīti no evemāni bhūtāni vināśamevāpīto bhavati nāhamatra bhogyaṃ paśyāmi" iti vacanāt |
analyzed: rthāḥ suṣuptasya amukta tvena arthakāḥ syuḥ na ca asau sarva upādhi vinirmuktaḥ āvirbhūta svarūpaḥ tat yatra etat suṣuptaḥ iti suṣuptam prakṛtya na āha khalu ayam evam saṃprati ātmānam jānāti ayam aham asmi iti no eva imāni bhūtāni vināśam eva api itas bhavati na aham atra bhogyam paśyāmi iti vacanāt

original: muktasya ca "paraṃ jyotirupasampadya svena rūpeṇābhiniṣpadyate" "sa tatra paryeti jakṣat krīḍan ramamāṇaḥ" "sa svarāh bhavati tasya sarveṣu lokeṣu kāmacāro bhavati" "sarvaṃ ha paśyaḥ paśyati sarvamāpnoti sarvaśaḥ" iti sarvajñatvādi śrūyate, ataḥ suṣuptaḥ saṃsarannevāyastasarvakaraṇo jñānabhogādyaśakto viśramasthānaṃparamātmānamupasampadyāśvastaḥ
analyzed: muktasya ca param jyotiḥ upasampadya svena rūpeṇa abhiniṣpadyate sa tatra paryeti jakṣat krīḍan ramamāṇaḥ sa svarāh bhavati tasya sarveṣu lokeṣu kāmacāraḥ bhavati sarvam ha paśyaḥ paśyati sarvam āpnoti sarvaśas iti sarvajña tva ādi śrūyate atas suṣuptaḥ saṃsaran eva āyasta sarva karaṇaḥ jñāna bhoga ādi aśaktaḥ viśrama sthānam paramātmānam upasampadya āśvastaḥ

original: punarbhogāyottiṣṭati || 9 ||
analyzed: punarbhogāya uttiṣṭati

original: || karmānutmṛtiśabdavidhyadhikaraṇaṃ samāptam || 3 ||
analyzed: karma an utmṛti śabda vidhi adhikaraṇam samāptam

original: mugdhe'rddhasampattiḥ pariśeṣāt || 10 ||
analyzed: mugdha ṛddha sampattiḥ pariśeṣāt 10

original: mugdhamadhikṛtya cintyate kimiyaṃ mūrcchā suṣuptyādiṣvanyatamā'vasthā? utāvasthāntaram? iti viśaye suṣuptyādīnāmanyatamāvasthāyāmeva mūrcchāprāsiddhayupapatteravasthāntarakalpane pramāṇābhāvādanyatamāvasthāiti prāpta ucyatemugdhe'rddhasampattiriti | mugdhe puruṣe yātasyāvasthāsā maraṇāyārddhasampattiḥ, kutaḥ pariśeṣāt |
analyzed: mugdham adhikṛtya cintyate kim iyam mūrcchā suṣupti ādiṣu anyatama avasthā uta avasthā antaram iti viśaye suṣupti ādīnām anyatama avasthāyām eva mūrcchā prāsiddhay upapatteḥ avasthā antara kalpane pramāṇa abhāvāt anyatama avasthā iti prāptaḥ ucyate mugdha īrddha sampattiḥ iti mugdhe puruṣe yātasya avasthā sā maraṇāya arddha sampattiḥ kutas pariśeṣāt

original: na tāvatsvapnajāgaraujñānābhāvāt, nimittavairūpyādākāravairūpyācca, na suṣuptimaraṇe, nimittaṃ hi mūrcchāyā abhidhātādiḥ, pāriśeṣyānmaraṇāyārddhasampattirmūrcchā, maraṇaṃ hi sarvaprāṇadehasambandhoparatiḥ, sūkṣmaprāṇadehasambandhāvasthitirmūrcchā || 10 || || mugdhādhikaraṇam samāptam || 4 ||
analyzed: na tāvat svapna jāgarau jñāna abhāvāt nimitta vairūpyāt ākāra vairūpyāt ca na suṣupti maraṇe nimittam hi mūrcchāyāḥ abhidhātā ādiḥ pāriśeṣyāt maraṇāya arddha sampattiḥ mūrcchā maraṇam hi sarva prāṇa deha sambandha uparatiḥ sūkṣma prāṇa deha sambandha avasthitiḥ mūrcchā mugdhādhikaraṇam samāptam 4

original: na sthānato'pi parasyobhayaliṅga sarvatra hi || 11 ||
analyzed: na sthānataḥ api parasya ubhaya liṅga sarvatra hi 11

original: doṣadarśanādvairāgyodayāya jīvasyāvasthāviśeṣānirūpitāḥ | idānīṃ brahmaprāptitṛṣṇājananāya prāpyasya brahmaṇo nirdoṣatvakalyāṇaguṇātmakatvapratipādanāyanārabhate, tatra jāgarasvaprasuṣuptimugdhyutkrāntiṣu sthāneṣu tattatsthānaprayuktā jīvasya ye doṣāste tadantaryāmiṇaḥ parasya brahmaṇo'pi tatra tatrāvasthitasya santi; neti vicāryyate |
analyzed: doṣa darśanāt vairāgya udayāya jīvasya avasthā viśeṣāḥ nirūpitāḥ idānīm brahma prāpti tṛṣṇā jananāya prāpyasya brahmaṇaḥ nirdoṣa tva kalyāṇa guṇa ātmaka tva pratipādanāya ārabhate tatra jāgara svapra suṣupti mugdhi utkrāntiṣu sthāneṣu tad tad sthāna prayuktāḥ jīvasya ye doṣāḥ te tad antaryāmiṇaḥ parasya brahmaṇaḥ api tatra tatra avasthitasya santi na iti vicāryyate

original: kiṃ yuktam? santīti, kutaḥ? tattadavasthaśarīre'vasthānāt | nanu "sambhogaprāptiriti cenna vaiśeṣyāt" "sthityadanābhyāṃ ca" ityādiṣuparasyākarmacaśyatvena doṣābhāva uktaḥ tatkathamakarmavaśyasya parasya brahmaṇastattatsthānasambandhāddoṣa ucyate, itthamucyate karmāṇyapi dehasamba
analyzed: kim yuktam santi iti kutas tad tad avasthā śarīra ivasthānāt nanu sambhoga prāptiḥ iti ced na vaiśeṣyāt sthiti adanābhyām ca ityādi ṣuparasya akarma caśya tvena doṣa abhāvaḥ uktaḥ tat katham akarma vaśyasya parasya brahmaṇaḥ tat tat sthāna sambandhāt doṣaḥ ucyate ittham ucyate karmāṇi api deha sambandhāt

original: ndhamāpādayanti puruṣārthajananāni bhavantīti "dehayogādvā" ityatroktam | tacca dahesambandhasyāpurūṣārthatvena bhavati | itarathā karmāṇyeva dukhaṃ janayiṣyanti kiṃ deha sambandhena;
analyzed: ndham āpādayanti puruṣa artha jananāni bhavanti iti deha yogāt vā iti atra uktam tat ca dahesambandhasya a purūṣa artha tvena bhavati itarathā karmāṇi eva dukham janayiṣyanti kim deha sambandhena

original: ato'karmavaśyatve satyapi nānāvidhāśucidehasambandho'puruṣārtha eva, atastanniyamanārthaṃ svecchayā tatpraveśe'pyapuruṣārthasambandho'varjjanīyaḥ, pūyaśoṇitādimajjanaṃ hi svecchākāritamapyapuruṣārtha eva |
analyzed: sati api nānāvidha aśuci deha sambandhaḥ puruṣa arthaḥ eva atas tad niyamana artham sva icchayā tad praveśa ipya puruṣa artha sambandhaḥ varjjanīyaḥ pūya śoṇita ādi majjanam hi sva icchā kāritam api apuruṣa arthaḥ eva

original: ato yadyapi jagadekakāraṇaṃ sarvajñatvādikalyāṇaguṇākaraṃ ca brahma, tathā'pi "yaḥ pṛthivyāṃ tiṣṭhan, ya ātmani tiṣṭhan, yaścakṣupi tiṣṭhan yo retasi tiṣṭhan" ityādivacanāt tatra tatrāvasthitasya tattatsambandharūpāpuruṣārthāḥ santiitievaṃ prāpte pracakṣmahe "na sthānato'pi parasya" iti na pṛthivyātmādisthānatopi parasya brahmaṇo'puruṣārthagandhaḥ
analyzed: atas yadi api jagat eka kāraṇam sarvajñatva ādi kalyāṇa guṇa ākaram ca brahma tathā api yaḥ pṛthivyām tiṣṭhan yaḥ ātmani tiṣṭhan yaḥ cakṣupi tiṣṭhan yaḥ retasi tiṣṭhan iti ādi vacanāt tatra tatra avasthitasya tad tad sambandha rūpa a puruṣa arthāḥ santi iti evam prāpte pracakṣmahe na sthānataḥ api parasya iti na pṛthivī ātma ādi sthānataḥ upi parasya brahmaṇā upuruṣa artha gandhaḥ

original: sambhavati | kutaḥ? ubhayaliṅgaṃ sarvatra hiyataḥ sarvatra śrutismṛtiṣu parabrahmobhayaliṅgamubhayalakṣaṇamabhidhīyatenirastanikhiladoṣatvakalyāṇaguṇākaratvalakṣaṇopetamityarthaḥ "apahatapāpmā vijaro vimṛtyurviśoko vijighatso'pipāsaḥ satyakāmaḥ satyasaṅkalpaḥ" "samastakalyāṇaguṇātmako'sau svaśaktileśoddhṛtabhūtasargaḥ |
analyzed: sambhavati kutas ubhaya liṅgam sarvatra sarvatra śruti smṛtiṣu para brahma ubhaya liṅgam ubhaya lakṣaṇam abhidhīyate nirasta nikhila doṣa tva kalyāṇa guṇa ākara tva lakṣaṇa upetam iti arthaḥ apahata pāpmā vijaraḥ vimṛtyuḥ viśokaḥ vijighatsaḥ pipāsaḥ satya kāmaḥ satya saṅkalpaḥ samasta kalyāṇa guṇa ātmakaḥ usau sva śakti leśa uddhṛta bhūta sargaḥ

original: tejobalaiśvaryamahāvabodhasuvīryaśakatyādiguṇaikarāśiḥ | paraḥ parāṇāṃ sakalā na yatra kleśādayaḥ santi parāvareśe" "samastaheyarahitaṃ viṣṇvākhyaṃ paramaṃ padam" ityādi
analyzed: tejaḥ bala aiśvarya mahā avabodha su vīrya śakati ādi guṇa eka rāśiḥ paraḥ parāṇām sakalāḥ na yatra kleśa ādayaḥ santi parāvara īśe samasta heya rahitam viṣṇu ākhyam paramam padam ityādi

original: śrutismṛtibhya ubhayalakṣaṇaṃ hi brahmāvagatam || 11 ||

original: bhedāditi cenna pratyekamatadvacanāt || 12 ||
analyzed: bhedāt iti ced na pratyekam a tad vacanāt 12

original: yathā jīvasya prajāpativākyāvagatāpahapāpmatvādyubhavaliṅgasyāpi devādidehayogarūpāvasthābhedādapuruṣārtha yogaḥ; tathā'ntaryāmiṇaḥ parasyāpi svato'pahatapāpmatvādyubhayaliṅgasya tattaddevādiśarīrayogarūpāvasthābhedādapuruṣārthayogo'varjjanīya
analyzed: yathā jīvasya prajāpati vākya avagata apaha pāpma tva ādi ubhava liṅgasya api deva ādi deha yoga rūpa avasthā bhedāt apuruṣa artha yogaḥ tathā antaryāmiṇaḥ parasya api svatā upahata pāpma tva ādi ubhaya liṅgasya tat tat deva ādi śarīra yoga rūpa avasthā bhedāt apuruṣa artha yogaḥ varjjanīya

original: iti cettanna, pratyekamatadvacanāt "yaḥ pṛthivyāṃ tiṣṭhan, ya ātmani niṣṭha"nnityā diṣu pratiparyāyaṃ "sa ta ātmā'ntaryāmyamṛtaḥ" ityantaryāmiṇo'mṛtatvavacanena tatra tatra svecchayāniyamanaṃ kurvatastattatsambandhaprayuktāpuruṣārthapratiṣedhāt | jīvasya tu tat svarūpantirohitamiti "parābhidhyānāttu tirohita"mityatroktam |
analyzed: iti ced tat na pratyekam a tad vacanāt yaḥ pṛthivyām tiṣṭhan yaḥ ātmani niṣṭhan iti ā diṣu pratiparyāyam sa te ātmā antaryāmī amṛtaḥ iti antaryāmiṇaḥ umṛta tva vacanena tatra tatra sva icchayā aniyamanam kurvataḥ tat tat sambandha prayukta a puruṣa artha pratiṣedhāt jīvasya tu tat sva rūpam tirohitam iti para abhidhyānāt tu tirohitam iti atra uktam

original: nanu svecchayā kurvato'pi tattadvastusvabhāvāyattā puruṣārthasambandho'varjjanīya ityuktam; naitadyuktaṃ, na hyacidvastvapi svabhāvato'puruṣārthasvarūpaṃ kamarvaśyānāṃ tu karmasvabhāvānuguṇyena paramapuruṣasaṅkalpādekameva vastu kālabhedena puruṣabhedena ca sukhāya duḥkhāya ca bhavati;
analyzed: nanu sva icchayā kurvataḥ api tat tat vastu svabhāva āyattā puruṣa artha sambandhaḥ varjjanīyaḥ iti uktam na etat yuktam na hi acit vastu api kamarvaśyānām tu karma svabhāva ānuguṇyena paramapuruṣa saṅkalpāt ekam eva vastu kāla bhedena puruṣa bhedena ca sukhāya duḥkhāya ca bhavati

original: vastusvarūpaprayukte tu tādrūpye sarvaṃ sarvadā sarvasya sukhāyaiva duḥkhāyaiva vā syāt; na caivaṃ dṛśyate; tathā coktaṃ "narakasvargasaṃjñe vai pāpapuṇye dvijottama? | vastvekameva duḥkhāya sukhāyerṣyāgamāya ca | kopāya ca yatastasmādvastu vastvātmakaṃ kutaḥ | tadeva prītaye bhūtvā punarduḥkhāya jāyate | tadeva kopāya yataḥ prasādāya ca jāyate |
analyzed: vastu svarūpa prayukte tu tādrūpye sarvam sarvadā sarvasya sukhāya eva duḥkhāya eva vā syāt na ca evam dṛśyate tathā ca uktam naraka svarga saṃjñe vai pāpa puṇye dvijottama vastu ekam eva duḥkhāya sukhāya īrṣyā āgamāya ca kopāya ca yatas tasmāt vastu vastu ātmakam kutas tat eva prītaye bhūtvā punar duḥkhāya jāyate tat eva kopāya yatas prasādāya ca jāyate

original: tasmād duḥkhātmakaṃ nāsti na ca kiñcitsukhātmakam" iti | ato jīvasya karmavaśyatvāttattatkarmānuguṇyena tattadvastusambandha evāpuruṣārthaḥ syāt, parasya tu brahmaṇaḥ svādhīnasya sa eva sambandhastattadvicitraniyamanarūpalīlārasāyaiva syāt || 12 ||
analyzed: tasmāt duḥkha ātmakam nā asti na ca kiñcid sukha ātmakam iti atas jīvasya karma vaśya tvāt tad tad karma ānuguṇyena tad tad vastu sambandhaḥ eva a puruṣa arthaḥ syāt parasya tu brahmaṇaḥ svādhīnasya saḥ eva sambandhaḥ tat tat vicitra niyamana rūpa līlā rasāya eva syāt

analyzed: api ca evam eke 13

original: api caike śākhina ekasminneva dehasaṃyoge jīvasyāpuruṣārthaṃ parasya tu tadabhāvaṃ niyamanarūpaiśvaryāyattadīptiyogaṃ ca svaśabdenādhīyate "dvā suparṇā suyujā sakhāyā samānaṃ vṛkṣaṃ pariṣasvajāte | tayoranyaḥ pippalaṃ svādvattyanaśnannanyo'bhicākaśīti" iti |
analyzed: api ca eke śākhinaḥ ekasmin eva deha saṃyoge jīvasya a puruṣa artham parasya tu tad abhāvam niyamana rūpa aiśvarya āyatta dīpti yogam ca sva śabdena adhīyate dvā suparṇā su yujā sakhāyā samānam vṛkṣam pariṣasvajāte tayoḥ anyaḥ pippalam svādvatti an aśnan anyaḥ abhicākaśīti iti

original: atha syāt "anena jīvenātmanā'nupraviśya nāmarūpe vyākaravāṇi" iti brahmātmakajīvānupraveśapūrvakaṃ nāmarūpavyākaraṇamiti brahmaṇo'pi tadātmabhūtasya devamanuṣyādirūpatvaṃ tannāmabhākatvaṃ cāsti, tataśca "brāhmaṇo yajeta" ityādividhiniṣedhaśāstragocaratvena karmavaśyatvamavarjjanīyamiti tatrāha
analyzed: atha syāt anena jīvena ātmanā anupraviśya nāma rūpe vyākaravāṇi iti brahma ātmaka jīva anupraveśa pūrvakam nāma rūpa vyākaraṇam iti brahmaṇaḥ api tad ātma bhūtasya deva manuṣya ādi rūpa tvam tad nāma bhāka tvam ca asti tatas ca brāhmaṇaḥ yajeta ityādi vidhi niṣedha śāstra gocara tvena karma vaśyatvam avarjanīyam iti tatra āha

original: "yathendrāya rājñe puroḍāśamekādaśakapālaṃ nirvapet" "indrāyādhirājāya" indrayasvarājñe" itīndrasyaiva rājatvādiguṇaviśiṣṭatve'pi tattadguṇasambandhyākārasya bhinnatvātpradānāvṛttiḥ kriyate, taduktaṃ sāṅkarṣaṇe "nānā vā devatāpṛthaktvāt" iti || 42 || || pradānādhikaraṇaṃ samāptam ||

original: taittirīyake daharavidyānantaramadhīyate "sahasraśīrṣaṃ devaṃ viśvākṣaṃ viśvaśambhuvam | viśvaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ devamakṣaraṃ paramaṃ prabhum" ityārabhya "so'kṣaraḥ paramaḥ svarāda" ityantam | tatra saṃśayaḥ kiṃ pūrvaprakṛtavidyayaikavidyātvena tadupāsyaviśeṣanirddhāraṇamanena kriyate? uta sarvavedāntoditaparavidyopāsyaviśeṣanirdhāraṇam iti |
analyzed: taittirīyake dahara vidyā anantaram adhīyate sahasra śīrṣam devam viśvākṣam viśva śambhuvam viśvam nārāyaṇam devam akṣaram paramam prabhum iti ārabhya sa ukṣaraḥ paramaḥ svarādaḥ ityantam tatra saṃśayaḥ kim pūrva prakṛta vidyayā ekavidyā tvena tad upāsya viśeṣa nirddhāraṇam anena kriyate uta sarva vedānta udita paravidyā upāsya viśeṣa nirdhāraṇam iti

original: kiṃ yuktam? daharavidyopāsyaviśeṣanirdhāraṇamiti | kutaḥ? prakaraṇāt | pūrvasminnanuvāke daharavidyā hi prakṛtā "dahaṃ vipāṣmaṃ paraveśmabhūtaṃ yatpuṇḍarīkaṃ puramadhyasaṃstham | tatrāpi dahraha gaganaṃ viśokastasmin yadantastadupāsitavyam" iti |
analyzed: kim yuktam dahara vidyā upāsya viśeṣa nirdhāraṇam iti kutas prakaraṇāt pūrvasmin anuvāke dahara vidyā hi prakṛtā daham vipāṣmam para veśma bhūtam yat puṇḍarīkam pura madhya saṃstham tatra api dahra ha gaganam viśokaḥ tasmin yat antar tat upāsitavyam iti

original: asmiścānuvāke "padmakośapratīkāśaṃ hṛdayaṃ cāṣyadhomukham" ityādinā hṛdayapuṇḍarīkābhidhānamasya nārāyaṇānuvākyasya daharavidyopāsyanirdhāraṇārthatvamupodvaloyatīti |
analyzed: asmin ca anuvāke padma kośa pratīkāśam hṛdayam ca aṣi adhomukham ityādinā hṛdaya puṇḍarīka abhidhānam asya nārāyaṇa anuvākyasya dahara vidyā upāsya nirdhāraṇa artha tvam upodvaloyati iti

original: evaṃ prāpta pracakṣmaheliṅgabhūyastvāditi | asya nikhilaparavidyopāsyaviśeṣanirdhāraṇārthatve bhūyāṃsi liṅgāni dṛśyante, tathā hi paravidyāsvakṣaraśivaśumbhuparabrahmaparajyotiḥparatattvaparamātmādiśabdanirdiṣṭamupāsyaṃ vastviha taireva śabdairanūdya tasya nārāyaṇatvaṃ vidhīyate;
analyzed: evam prāpta pracakṣmahe liṅga bhūyaḥ tvāt iti asya nikhila para vidyā upāsya viśeṣa nirdhāraṇa artha tve bhūyāṃsi liṅgāni dṛśyante tathā hi para vidyāsu akṣara śiva śumbhu para brahma para jyotiḥ para tattva paramātma ādi śabda nirdiṣṭam upāsyam vastu iha taiḥ eva śabdaiḥ anūdya tasya nārāyaṇa tvam vidhīyate

original: bhūyasīṣu vidyāsu śrutānanūdya nārāyaṇatvavidhānabhūyastvaṃ nārā yaṇa eva sarvavidyāsupāsyamasthūlatvādiviśeṣitānandādiguṇakaṃ paraṃ brahmeti viśeṣanirṇaye bhūyobahutaraṃ liṅgaṃ bhavati | atra liṅgaśabdāścinhaparyāyaḥ, cinhabhūta vākyaṃ bahutaramastītyarthaḥ |
analyzed: bhūyasīṣu vidyāsu śrutān anūdya nārāyaṇa tva vidhāna bhūyastvam nārā yaṇe eva sarva vidyāsu upāsyam asthūla tva ādi viśeṣita ānanda ādi guṇakam param brahma iti viśeṣa nirṇaye bhūyaḥ bahutaram liṅgam bhavati atra liṅga śabdāḥ cinha paryāyaḥ cinha bhūta vākyam bahutaram asti iti arthaḥ

original: taddhi prakaraṇādvalīyaḥ, tadapyu ktamprathame kāṇḍe "śrutiliṅgavākyaprakaraṇastānasamākhyānāṃ samavāye paradaurvalyamarthaviprakarṣāt" iti | yattūktam"padmakośapratīkāśa"mityādivacanaṃ daharaśeṣatvamasyopodvalayatīti;
analyzed: tat hi prakaraṇāt valīyaḥ tat api u ktam prathame kāṇḍe śruti liṅga vākya prakaraṇa stāna samākhyānām samavāye para daurvalyam artha viprakarṣāt iti yat tu uktam padmakośa pratīkāśam ityādi vacanam dahara śeṣa tvam asya upodvalayati iti

original: tanna, balīyasā pramāṇena sarvavidyopāsyanirdhāraṇārthatve'dhṛte sati daharavidyāyāmapi tasyaiva nārāyaṇasyopāsyatvena tadvacanopapatteḥ |
analyzed: tat na balīyasā pramāṇena sarva vidyā upāsya nirdhāraṇa arthatve dhṛte sati daharavidyāyām api tasya eva nārāyaṇasya upāsya tvena tad vacana upapatteḥ

original: na ca "sahasraśīrṣam" ityādidvitīyānirdeśena pūrvānuvākoditopāsinā sambandhaḥ śaṅkanīyaḥ, "tasmin yadantastadupāsitavyam" ityupāsigatena kṛtpratyayenopāsyasya karmaṇo'bhihitatvāttadupāsye dvitīyānupapatteḥ, "viśvamevedaṃ puruṣaḥ" "tattvaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ paraḥ ityādiprathamānirdeśācca prathamārthe dvitīyā veditavyā |
analyzed: na ca sahasra śīrṣam ityādi dvitīyā nirdeśena pūrva anuvāka udita upāsinā sambandhaḥ śaṅkanīyaḥ tasmin yad antaḥ tat upāsitavyam iti upāsi gatena kṛt pratyayena upāsyasya karmaṇā ubhihita tvāt tad upāsye dvitīyā anupapatteḥ viśvam eva idam puruṣaḥ tattvam nārāyaṇaḥ paraḥ ityādi prathamā nirdeśāt ca prathamā arthe dvitīyā veditavyā

original: "antarvahiśca tatsarvaṃ vyāpya nārāyaṇaḥ sthitaḥ" "tasyāḥ śikhāyā madhye paramātmā vyavasthitaḥ | sa brahmā sa śivaḥ sendraḥ so'kṣaraḥ paramaḥ svarāṭ" iti nirdeśaiḥ sarvasmātparo nārāyaṇa eva sarvatropāsya iti nirṇīyamānatvācca prathamārthe dvitīyeti niścīyate || 43 || || liṅgabhūyastvādhikaraṇaṃ samāptam ||
analyzed: antar vahis ca tat sarvam vyāpya nārāyaṇaḥ sthitaḥ tasyāḥ śikhāyāḥ madhye paramātmā vyavasthitaḥ sa brahmā sa śivaḥ sa indraḥ sa ukṣaraḥ paramaḥ svarāj iti nirdeśaiḥ sarvasmāt paraḥ nārāyaṇaḥ eva sarvatra upāsyaḥ iti nirṇīyamāna tvāt ca prathama arthe dvitīyā iti niścīyate 43 liṅga bhūyaḥ tva adhikaraṇam samāptam

original: vājasaneyake'gnirahasye manaścidādayo'gnayaḥ śrūyante "manaścito vākcitaḥ prāṇacitaścakṣaścitaḥ śrotracitaḥ karmacito'gnicitaḥ" iti | tatra saṃśayaḥkimete manaścidādayaḥ sāmpādikatvena vidyārūpā agnayaḥ kriyāmayakratvanupraveśena kriyārūpāḥ? āhosvidvidyāmayakratvanupraveśena vidyārūpā eveti viśaye kriyārūpatvaṃ tāvadāhapūrvavikalpaḥityādinā |
analyzed: vājasaneyaka ignirahasye manaḥ cit ādayaḥ agnayaḥ śrūyante manaḥ citaḥ vāc citaḥ prāṇa citaḥ cakṣaḥ citaḥ śrotra citaḥ karma citaḥ agni citaḥ iti tatra saṃśayaḥ kim ete manaḥ cit ādayaḥ sāmpādika tvena vidyā rūpāḥ agnayaḥ kriyā maya kratu anupraveśena kriyā rūpāḥ āhosvit vidyā maya kratu anupraveśena vidyā rūpāḥ eva iti viśaye kriyā rūpa tvam tāvat āha pūrva vikalpaḥ ityādinā

original: cityāgnitvena sampāditānāmeṣāṃ manaścidādīnāṃ kratvanuprave

original: śasākāṅkṣāṇāṃ svadeśe kratuviṃdhyabhāvāt pūrvatra "asadvā idamagra āsīt" ityādineṣṭakacitasyāgneḥ prakṛta tvāt tasya ca kriyāmayakratvavyabhicāritvena tatra kratusannidhānāt tatprakaraṇagṛhītā manaścidādaḥ teneṣṭakacitenāgninā vikalpyamānāḥ kriyārūpā eva syuḥ | vidyārūpāṇāpi kriyāmayakratvanupraveśena kriyārūpatvaṃ mānasagrahavadupapadyate;
analyzed: śasa ākāṅkṣāṇām sva deśe kratu vidhi abhāvāt pūrvatra asat vai idam agre āsīt ityādinā iṣṭakā citasya agneḥ prakṛta tvāt tasya ca kriyā maya kratu avyabhicāri tvena tatra kratu sannidhānāt tad prakaraṇa gṛhītāḥ manaścit ādaḥ tena iṣṭakā citena agninā vikalpyamānāḥ kriyā rūpāḥ eva syuḥ kriyā maya kratu anupraveśena kriyā rūpa tvam mānasagraha vat upapadyate

original: yathā dvādaśāhe avivākye daśame'hani mānasagrahasya manoniṣpāsyagrahaṇāsādanastotraśastrapratyāhāraṇabhakṣaṇatvena vidyārūpasyāpi kriyāmayakratvaṅgatayā kriyārūpatvam, tathehāpi || 44 ||

original: atideśācca || 45 ||
analyzed: atideśāt ca 45

original: itaśceṣṭakacitenāgninā manaścidādīnāṃ vikalpaḥ kriyārūpatvaṃ cāvagamyata, "teṣāmekaika eva tāvān yāvānasau pūrvaḥ" iti pūrvasyeṣyakacitasyāgnervīryaṃ manaścidādiṣvatidiśyate; tena tulyakāryatvādvikalpaḥ, tataśceṣṭakacitavattatkratunivarrtanena tadaṅgabhūtā manaścidādayaḥ kriyāmayakratvanupraveśena kriyārūpā eveti || 45 ||

analyzed: kutas nirdhāraṇāt daśarnāt ca nirdhāraṇam tāvat te ha ete vidyā citaḥ eva vidyāyāḥ ha eva ete evaṃvidaḥ citāḥ bhavanti iti vā āhmanaḥ cakṣuḥ ādi vyāpārāṇām iṣṭakā ādi vat cayana anupapatteḥ manasā a sampādita agni tvena vidyā rūpa tve siddhe api vidyā citaḥ eva vidyayā ha eva ete iti ca avadhāraṇam vidyā maya kratu anvayena vidyā rūpa tva jñāpana artham iti niścīyate

original: dṛśyate cātraiṣāṃ śeṣī vidyārūpaḥ kratuḥ "te manasaivādhīyanta manasaivācīyanta manasaiṣu grahā agṛhyanta manasā'stuvanta manasā'śaṃsan yatkiñca yajñe karma kriyate yatkiñca yajñīyaṃ karma manasaiva teṣu manomayeṣu manaścitsumanomayamakriyata" iti |
analyzed: dṛśyate ca atra eṣām śeṣī vidyā rūpaḥ kratuḥ te manasā eva adhīyanta manasā eva acīyanta manasā eṣu grahāḥ agṛhyanta manasā astuvanta manasā aśaṃsan yat kiñca yajñe karma kriyate yat kiñca yajñīyam karma manasā eva teṣu manaḥ mayeṣu manaḥ citsu manaḥ mayam akriyata iti

original: iṣṭakaciteṣvagniṣu yatkriyāmayaṃ yajñīyaṃ karma kriyate, tanmanonirvartyeṣu manaścidādyagniṣu manomayamevākriyateti vacanāt kraturapi vidyāmayo'tra pratīyate || 46 ||

original: "tān haitānevaṃvide sarvadā sarvāṇi bhūtāni vicinvantyapi svapate" iti liṅgam | vākyaṃ ca "evaṃvide cinvanti" iti | samabhivyāhāro vākyam | evaṃvidevidyāmayakratumate sarvadā savarṇi bhūtāni vicinvantītyarthaḥ |
